Microsoft-1970393556986960.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER II - Core AI
Microsoft-1970393556986960.description:
Overview
Do you want to help define how developers build and run the next generation of AI applications and agents? CoreAI is building the AI-first application stack at the center of Microsoft's AI platform strategy, bringing together models, agents, tools, data, evaluation, security, governance, and developer experiences.
Microsoft Foundry Service is a unified, production-ready platform that enables developers and enterprises to build, deploy, evaluate, publish, and operate AI applications and agents at scale. Foundry Agent Service provides managed runtimes for prompt agents and hosted agents, integrates models and reusable tools, and delivers enterprise capabilities such as Microsoft Entra identity, role-based access control, private networking, content safety, tracing, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management. The platform supports both low-code and code-first development, allowing customers to use managed experiences or bring their own agent code and frameworks.
Making agent development simple creates challenging engineering opportunities across distributed systems, secure execution, session and state management, workload scheduling, scalability, reliability, observability, networking, identity, governance, and cost efficiency. Our services must provide a consistent developer experience while supporting diverse agent frameworks, tools, models, and compute environments for enterprise workloads.
The rapid evolution of generative AI and agentic applications is reshaping how software is built and operated. Come join CoreAI and help build Microsoft Foundry Service—the platform that enables every developer to create secure, reliable, and scalable AI applications and agents.
Responsibilities
We are looking for strong engineers who are passionate about building new AI platform capabilities while operating a globally distributed service. The ideal candidate can independently produce high-quality solutions and contribute to a collaborative and diverse team environment across organizations and geographies. You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving space, learning quickly, handling ambiguity, and changing direction as customer needs and AI technologies evolve.
In this role, you will design, build, and deliver services, features, and developer tools for Microsoft Foundry Service, with a focus on Foundry Agent Service and Hosted Agents. You may work on managed agent runtimes, secure and isolated execution, agent session lifecycle, workload scheduling and autoscaling, identity and networking integration, tools and model connectivity, observability, evaluation, publishing, and support for customer-managed compute such as Azure Kubernetes Service. You will work across open-source and Microsoft platform components written in multiple programming languages.
This is a unique opportunity to work on large-scale distributed AI systems and deliver foundational capabilities that are central to Microsoft's strategy for enterprise AI applications and agents.

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
Hands-on experience with distributed systems, cloud services, containers, orchestration platforms, or production AI infrastructure.
Proven ability to diagnose complex technical issues and improve the reliability, scalability, performance, security, and cost efficiency of online services.
Excellent
written
and oral communication skills.
Experience in technical leadership in driving engineering roadmaps, leading v-teams, mentoring and helping others grow technically is a plus.
Experience building AI applications or agents using models, tools, retrieval, agent frameworks, evaluation, tracing, or observability is a plus.
Experience with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service, secure workload isolation, or cloud networking is a plus.
Experience using public cloud services, including Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, and familiarity with identity, role-based access control, private networking, and operational monitoring.

Microsoft-1970393557042176.title: Senior Software Engineer - gpu cogs/efficiency
Microsoft-1970393557042176.description:
Overview
Microsoft 365 and Copilot run on Substrate & Work IQ (SWIQ)—the trusted data and intelligence platform powering service health, operational excellence, business insights, and AI-driven decision making across Microsoft's largest cloud services. As Microsoft 365 and Copilot continue to grow at unprecedented scale, SWIQ provides the foundational intelligence that connects product experiences, infrastructure, operations, and business outcomes, enabling teams to build, operate, and innovate with confidence.
The SWIQ Performance Team is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to improve infrastructure efficiency and build the trusted intelligence platforms that power Microsoft 365 and Copilot economics. You will design and operate systems that connect product usage, service dependencies, fleet inventory, hardware constraints, utilization, operational telemetry, and Finance-aligned cost models into a unified foundation for bare-metal COGS and efficiency. These capabilities enable engineering, finance, and business teams to understand cost drivers, reduce stranded resources, improve fleet utilization, optimize investments, and make reliable capacity decisions at cloud scale.
In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of scalable distributed systems and intelligence solutions that transform complex operational and business signals into actionable insights. You will partner across engineering, product, and business teams to improve visibility into the relationships between cost, quality, reliability, efficiency, and customer value across rapidly evolving Copilot and AI-powered experiences.
You will also help advance AI-native transformation by applying agents, intelligent automation, and machine-assisted decision making to improve operational efficiency, identify optimization opportunities, and accelerate engineering outcomes.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design and deliver scalable platforms that connect operational telemetry, product usage, infrastructure consumption, and data into trusted intelligence and decision-support systems.
Drive architecture, implementation, and operational excellence for large-scale cloud services that power Microsoft 365 and Copilot economics insights.
Develop solutions that improve visibility into cost drivers, resource efficiency, service dependencies, and business outcomes, helping teams make data-driven decisions.
Apply AI, design agents, and intelligent automation to streamline operational workflows, identify optimization opportunities, and improve engineering productivity.
Partner across engineering, product, finance, and business teams to translate complex requirements into scalable platform capabilities and measurable business impact.
Lead technical initiatives, influence architecture decisions, and drive adoption of shared platform capabilities across multiple teams.
Improve platform reliability, observability, data quality, and operational efficiency through engineering best practices and automation.
Contribute to technical excellence, and help establish reusable patterns and capabilities that increase organizational effectiveness.
Microsoft-1970393557042176.requirements:
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR equivalent experience.
Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR equivalent experience.
Experience building scalable software systems that process large volumes of data.
Passion for AI-native engineering and automation, including applying intelligent systems to improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
Demonstrated ability to drive complex technical initiatives from design through production deployment and measurable results.
Solid software engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems design, cloud architecture, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
Experience collaborating across teams and disciplines to solve ambiguous technical problems and deliver customer and business value.
Experience leveraging data, analytics, observability, or AI technologies to improve service performance, operational efficiency, or business decision making.
Proven ability to contribute to a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, data platforms supporting mission-critical services.
Experience with large language models (LLMs), agent platforms.
Experience developing data-driven insights platforms.
Experience establishing engineering standards, operational practices, automation frameworks, or governance models for cloud-scale services.
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Microsoft-1970393557046973.title: Software Engineer II - Azure SRE Agent
Microsoft-1970393557046973.description:
Overview
Within Microsoft CoreAI, the Azure SRE Agent Platform team builds and operates production AI agents that help engineers detect, diagnose, and mitigate reliability issues across Azure services and customer workloads. Our work turns modern AI systems into reliable, production-grade operational tooling for AI ops scenarios, with a focus on quality, safety, and real-world impact.
We are looking for a Software Engineer II to help build the next generation of agentic systems for cloud operations. This role is for engineers who care deeply about product quality, end-to-end ownership, and the details that separate an exciting prototype from a system people trust during critical moments.
Our work spans the full lifecycle of agentic systems in production. We design and improve the core capabilities that shape agent behavior, including tool design, planning and execution loops, orchestration, evaluation, and safety guardrails. We also build the operational foundations that make those systems dependable in practice, including observability, progressive delivery, reliability engineering, and live-site learning.
Engineers on this team operate with high autonomy in a highly agile environment: short cycles, thin slices, feature flags, progressive delivery, and constant learning. We are looking for people with high agency and a strong bias for action - engineers who take ownership of ambiguous problems, move quickly, learn from production, and continuously raise the quality bar as they ship.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Take ownership of important areas of the Azure SRE Agent Platform, including agent capabilities, orchestration, evaluation, and supporting platform services
Build and iterate on agentic systems, including tools, planning and execution loops, evaluations, and safety mechanisms
Design and ship reliable capabilities that improve incident detection, diagnosis, mitigation, and operational learning
Use telemetry, experiments, evaluations, and user feedback to guide iteration and investment
Contribute to resilient, observable systems that operate safely and effectively in production
Partner closely with engineers, SREs, and product counterparts to turn ambiguous problems into high-quality shipped solutions
Participate in debugging, live-site learning, and post-incident hardening to continuously improve system quality
Contribute to architecture, engineering standards, and development practices across the team

Microsoft-1970393557022799.title: Regional DC Ops AI Solutions Lead
Microsoft-1970393557022799.description:
Overview
As a Microsoft Regional DC Ops AI Solutions Lead, serve as the technical authority and AI Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the APAC Data Center Operations (DC Ops) AI Board, leading the strategy, governance, architecture, deployment, and operationalization of AI-enabled solutions across APAC Data Center Operations. This job will allow you to build a strong understanding of demonstrate and further develop your expertise in datacenter services. It will also provide you with opportunities of working with teams across various geographies.
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services.You will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
This role aligns business priorities with a security-first culture and leverages AI technologies to improve operational efficiency, service delivery, safety, compliance, reliability, and business outcomes. The AI Solutions Lead oversees the end-to-end lifecycle of AI initiatives from opportunity identification through pilot execution, production deployment, adoption, governance, and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with Microsoft security, privacy, safety, and Responsible AI standards.
The role partners closely with Operations, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Product Engineering, and business stakeholders to translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable value across Data Center Operations.
Responsibilities
AI Strategy, Governance & Technical Leadership
Serve as the APAC DC Operations AI SME and trusted advisor, driving AI strategy, governance, architecture, and adoption across Data Center Operations.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency, service delivery, reliability, safety, security, and business outcomes.
Establish AI standards, governance frameworks, production readiness requirements, and operational support models aligned with Responsible AI, security, compliance, and Microsoft policies.
Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI initiatives from opportunity assessment and solution design through deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.
Data Center Operations
Partner with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable AI solutions that support operational objectives, compliance requirements, and security-first practices.
Drive AI-enabled improvements in incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), operational troubleshooting, process optimization, and KPI/OKR performance.
Support operational planning, risk mitigation, cost optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across Data Center Operations.
Data Center Work Environment
Lead organizational change management and adoption activities to integrate AI capabilities into operational workflows.
Collaborate across teams to anticipate operational changes, evaluate impacts, and implement scalable solutions that improve workforce productivity and operational effectiveness.
Promote a culture of innovation, security, safety, compliance, and continuous learning across the organization.
Service Delivery & Stakeholder Leadership
Drive cross-functional programs and partnerships to achieve service delivery objectives, operational KPIs, and business priorities.
Analyze operational metrics, identify trends and risks, and recommend improvements to enhance customer experience, service quality, and operational resilience.
Influence stakeholders, remove delivery obstacles, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of AI-driven solutions across the business

Microsoft’s Commercial Solution Area (CSA) sets the sales strategy, leads technical sales, and operations as a hub for the Commercial Solution Areas and Support Services that power the Microsoft Cloud. Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Microsoft-1970393557054255.title: Sr Activation GTM Manager Mgr- Cloud & AI
Microsoft-1970393557054255.description:
Overview
The Sales Enablement & Operations (SE&O) team plays an essential role in translating Microsoft’s Commercial Strategy to a local execution plan and driving operational excellence to achieve the greatest results possible. Our team drives cross-Region, cross-Area and cross-Subsidiary insight and execution excellence, bringing strategy and priorities to life by accelerating the pace of transformation and enabling Microsoft to deliver business impact at scale.
As the
Activation GTM Manager for Cloud & AI in GCR Digital Native
, you will accelerate revenue growth, boost field agility, and deliver results with our field sellers by deepening your partnership with key stakeholders across GCR DN team, Sales Excellence, sales, marketing, customer success, and partner functions, supporting One-Microsoft. You will focus on driving alignment across processes and tools, leading with a cross-solution approach to optimize pipelines, ensuring effective communication and flawless execution, and leveraging insights to drive data-driven decision-making. This role is critical to driving customer adoption at scale, driven by deep solution play domain, product truth, and partnerships with sales, marketing, operations, and sales excellence.
We’re looking for a highly driven, motivated marketing or sales individual to join our Go-to-Market (GTM) team. This role requires someone who acts as a thought leader, tracks success criteria and performance metrics, works with emergent technology, creates alignment and action across teams, removes roadblocks, and simplifies complex concepts. This individual truly lives for big challenges. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, and hone your leadership skills.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities

Microsoft-1970393557041551.title: Senior Software Engineer - M365 Storage Fabric
Microsoft-1970393557041551.description:
Overview
We engineer the systems that keep Microsoft 365 running—always. As part of the High Availability (HA) team, you'll build and operate mission-critical infrastructure that protects customer data and ensures service resilience across global data centers. Our work spans three evolving areas: large-scale distributed storage and high-availability systems; AI agents and agentic engineering that automate operations and software development; and applied AI, machine learning, and data science that enable intelligent prediction, decision-making, and optimization.
As a
Senior Software Engineer,
you will design and implement innovative solutions across these areas, tackling complex challenges in distributed systems while applying emerging AI technologies to transform how cloud infrastructure is built and operated. You will work on projects ranging from replication and recovery systems and next-generation storage architectures to autonomous incident mitigation, AI-powered engineering workflows, and predictive models for system reliability. The focus of your work will evolve with our technical priorities, offering opportunities to deepen your expertise and drive meaningful innovation across multiple domains.
We are looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals, practical experience with modern AI technologies, and a passion for continuous learning. This opportunity will allow you to solve challenging problems at global scale, explore emerging technologies, and shape the next generation of intelligent and resilient cloud infrastructure.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and operate large-scale distributed storage and high-availability systems, including data replication, database copy management, failover, recovery, and evolving storage architectures, to improve reliability, scalability, performance, and efficiency.
Build and apply AI agents and agentic workflows to automate incident investigation, mitigation, root-cause analysis, software development, testing, debugging, and other operational and engineering processes.
Apply AI, machine learning, and data science techniques to analyze large-scale operational data, develop predictive and decision models, identify system risks, and optimize reliability and resource efficiency.
Independently drive complex engineering projects from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, production operations, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across storage, infrastructure, and AI engineering to solve challenging technical problems and advance system architecture and engineering practices.
Continuously explore, evaluate, and apply emerging technologies and engineering approaches to deliver innovative, practical solutions.

Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR equivalent experience.
Experience designing, developing, and operating large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or backend services.
Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, system architecture, concurrency, reliability, and fault tolerance.
Hands-on experience using AI and developing or integrating AI agents and agentic workflows to solve practical engineering problems.
Foundational understanding of machine learning, statistical analysis, or data-driven modeling, with the ability to evaluate and apply these approaches to engineering problems.
Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex technical problems, deliver high-quality production software, and continuously learn and adopt emerging technologies.
Experience with distributed storage systems, databases, replication protocols, consistency models, or advanced storage technologies such as erasure coding and Shingled Magnetic Recording (SMR).
Experience building production AI agent systems, including tool integration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), orchestration, evaluation, safety guardrails, and autonomous task execution.
Hands-on experience with applied machine learning, data science, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, or decision optimization, particularly using large-scale operational telemetry.
Experience applying agentic engineering to automate software development, testing, troubleshooting, or incident management workflows.
Experience designing, troubleshooting, and optimizing highly available services in large-scale cloud production environments.
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft-1970393557007799.description:

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Software Engineer to help build and evolve the next generation of storage, data, and distributed platform services that power Microsoft 365 and AI workloads at hyperscale.
In this role, you will design, develop, and operate highly reliable, low-latency, and scalable services. You will work across system architecture, performance optimization, reliability engineering, and AI-native development practices to modernize core platform components and accelerate engineering productivity.
You will partner with engineers, architects, product leaders, and principal engineers to solve challenging technical problems involving distributed systems, storage infrastructure, databases, high-concurrency services, and cloud-scale operations.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and operate large-scale distributed services and platform components.
Drive feature development from requirements through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Improve scalability, reliability, availability, and performance of mission-critical services.
Investigate and resolve complex production issues across distributed systems.
Optimize latency, throughput, resource efficiency, and storage utilization.
Develop and maintain service telemetry, monitoring, diagnostics, and automated recovery mechanisms.
Contribute to architectural design reviews and technical decision making.
Collaborate across teams to deliver end-to-end platform solutions.
Apply AI-assisted development tools and AI-native engineering practices to improve development velocity and software quality.
Build automation for testing, validation, deployment, and operational workflows.
Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, mentoring, design discussions, and operational best practices.
Participate in on-call rotations and drive improvements that reduce operational burden.
Leverage data and production insights to guide technical investments and architectural evolution.

Microsoft-1970393556978919.title: Software Engineer 2(M365 Storage Fabric team)
Microsoft-1970393556978919.description:
Overview
Microsoft 365 (M365) powers collaboration and productivity experiences for hundreds of millions of users worldwide. As cloud services and AI-powered experiences continue to evolve, Microsoft 365 requires intelligent platform capabilities that can efficiently manage resources, maintain service health, and deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale. The M365 Storage Fabric team develops foundational infrastructure and platform services that improve efficiency, resiliency, and scalability across Microsoft 365. We build systems that help services adapt to changing workload demands, optimize resource utilization, and operate effectively under dynamic traffic conditions. Our work directly enables next-generation AI-powered experiences while maintaining the reliability and efficiency expected from Microsoft 365. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, large-scale services, and AI-native engineering practices.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
The team is looking for a proactive engineer to:
Design and develop features for large-scale distributed systems and backend infrastructure services.
Help improve service reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational excellence through data-driven engineering.
Build platform capabilities that optimize resource utilization and workload execution across Microsoft 365 services.
Develop telemetry, monitoring, diagnostics, and automation solutions to improve system health and operational visibility.
Investigate production issues and participate in live-site mitigation and recovery efforts.
Collaborate closely with partner teams across Microsoft 365 to deliver end-to-end platform capabilities.
Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing, deployment, and operational support.
Continuously learn emerging technologies, distributed systems concepts, and AI-assisted engineering practices.
Contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python

Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR equivalent experience.
Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design.
Experience developing features or components as part of a service or distributed system.
Ability to debug issues, write maintainable code, and deliver features end-to-end with appropriate guidance.
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, or equivalent tools as part of day-to-day development workflows.
Demonstrated ability to review, validate, and refine AI-generated code, tests, documentation, and troubleshooting guidance before production use.
Experience contributing to backend services or distributed systems, including understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance tradeoffs.

Experience working with telemetry, logging, monitoring, and production diagnostics.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or similar.
Experience working with:
Microservices and service-oriented architecture
Event-driven systems and APIs
Resource management or infrastructure systems
Containerized or cloud-native environments
Exposure to AI-powered services, large-scale inference workloads, or rapidly changing traffic patterns.
Ability to effectively collaborate with AI coding assistants and engineering agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining quality and ownership.

Microsoft-1970393557046974.title: Software Engineer II - Agentic Sandbox
Microsoft-1970393557046974.description:
Overview
Azure Container Apps is part of the broader Azure organization, with a mission to empower developers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate highly scalable serverless and cloud-native applications without managing the underlying infrastructure.
The Azure Container Apps Sandboxes team is building a secure execution platform for the agentic era. Azure Container Apps Sandboxes provides fast, hardware-isolated compute environments for running untrusted and AI-generated code. Each sandbox offers an independent execution boundary with programmable lifecycle, networking, storage, and state-management capabilities.
The platform enables scenarios including AI agent tool execution, multi-tenant application platforms, interactive development environments, secure code execution, and ephemeral CI/CD workloads.
We are looking for a Software Engineer II to help build the next generation of Azure Container Apps Sandboxes. In this role, you will contribute to capabilities spanning sandbox provisioning, workload isolation, lifecycle management, networking, storage, observability, and large-scale orchestration.
This role is for engineers who care deeply about product quality, security, reliability, and end-to-end ownership. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and partner teams to turn ambiguous requirements into secure and dependable platform capabilities.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we bring a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. We build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, test, and operate capabilities for sandbox provisioning, orchestration, lifecycle management, and secure code execution.
Build reliable control-plane and data-plane services that manage isolated, short-lived, and stateful compute environments at cloud scale.
Contribute to capabilities such as rapid startup, burst scaling, scale-to-zero, suspend and resume, snapshots, persistent storage, and custom container images.
Develop secure workload-isolation mechanisms across compute, networking, storage, identity, and secrets.
Build networking features including egress policies, private connectivity, credential injection, and virtual network integration.
Write and review high-quality production code with a focus on correctness, maintainability, performance, diagnosability, and security.
Develop and improve public APIs and developer experiences across SDKs, command-line tools, infrastructure-as-code integrations, and the Azure portal.
Create automated tests and validation systems covering functionality, security, workload isolation, performance, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Use telemetry, experiments, customer feedback, and production insights to guide product improvements and engineering investments.
Build observability capabilities, including metrics, tracing, logging, dashboards, and alerts, to understand platform and workload behavior.
Participate in live-site operations, incident response, debugging, and post-incident hardening.
Partner with engineers, product managers, security teams, and service partners to turn product scenarios into high-quality shipped solutions.
Contribute to architecture discussions, engineering standards, code reviews, and development practices across the team.
Take ownership of assigned problem areas and drive them from design and implementation through deployment and production operation.

Required/Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
and 4+ years
of technical engineering experience coding in one or more languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Go, Java, Rust, or Python;
OR equivalent experience.
Experience designing, implementing, and operating distributed systems, cloud services, or platform components.
Strong engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, systems design, testing, and debugging.
Experience delivering production software with consideration for reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
Ability to independently own engineering tasks and collaborate effectively with engineers and partner teams.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex issues in production environments.
Additional or Preferred Qualifications
Experience with containers, OCI images, Kubernetes, container orchestration, or serverless platforms.
Experience with virtualization technologies, microVMs, Linux internals, sandboxing, or workload isolation.
Experience building or operating multi-tenant cloud services.
Experience with cloud networking concepts, including virtual networks, private connectivity, DNS, proxies, firewalls, or network policy enforcement.
Experience with identity, authorization, secrets management, and secure credential handling.
Experience with snapshotting, checkpoint and restore, persistent storage, or distributed state-management systems.
Experience building public APIs, SDKs, command-line tools, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.
Experience building platforms for AI agents, secure code execution, development environments, or dynamically generated workloads.
Experience with service observability, progressive delivery, incident response, and live-site operations.
A strong product mindset and demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous requirements into reliable, user-focused solutions.
Experience contributing to open-source projects is a plus.

Microsoft-1970393557041182.description:
Overview
Microsoft AI is building the next generation of AI platforms and experiences. The Foundry Billing team plays a critical role in enabling these experiences by providing reliable, accurate, and scalable billing capabilities across Azure AI Foundry.
We are looking for a
Software Engineer
who is passionate about building large-scale distributed systems and solving complex engineering problems. You will work on the end-to-end billing platform that enables new AI models, services, and commercial offerings to launch with accurate and trustworthy usage and billing.
Foundry Billing is responsible for commercial implementation readiness, usage correctness and attribution, billing delivery and charge assurance, reconciliation, and customer usage observability.
Responsibilities
As a Software Engineer on the Foundry Billing team, you will:
Design, implement, test, and operate scalable billing services
that process high-volume AI usage and reliably deliver billing data to downstream Azure Commerce and Marketplace systems.
Enable new AI models and features for billing
, working with partner teams to define billing units, meters, usage semantics, attribution, and end-to-end launch readiness.
Improve
billing correctness and reliability
, including usage validation, deduplication, reconciliation, replay and recovery mechanisms, and detection of missing or incorrect billing data. These are core guarantees of the Foundry Billing platform.
Build
automation and engineering tools
for billing validation, model onboarding, deployment, monitoring, backfill, remediation, and other production operations.
Develop effective
monitoring, diagnostics, and alerting
to detect billing delays, data loss, incorrect metering, and service reliability issues before they affect customers.
Enable
Foundry FinOps and new business scenarios and platform capabilities
by collaborating with different teams.

Microsoft-1970393557055489.title: Critical Environment Field Service Engineer
Microsoft-1970393557055489.description:
Overview
Business Function Overview:
In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a
CO+I CE Field Service Engineer
(FSE).
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I FSE, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!
Responsibilities
As a successful CO+I CE Field Service Engineer,
your success will be measured by:
Data Center Operations
Ensures compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.
Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.
Service Delivery
Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency
Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters (MOP/SOP/EOP review, RCAs, FMEAs, change governance, and risk mitigation)
Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters
Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed
Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs)
Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio
Data Center Work Environment
Shares best practices; assists others in learning role, process, procedures.
Provides mentorship across data centers for specific expertise.
Seeks training opportunities that meet the interest of the business as well as own career goals and objectives.
Suggests ways for reducing risk of performing maintenance; works with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
Suggests improvements in implementation based on depth of understanding.
Contributes to a positive team environment by learning and adopting best practices.
Contributes constructively during team meetings and in cross-disciplinary collaborations within the service team.
Ownership
In alignment with management priorities, holds self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service).
Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

Data Center Operations

Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.

Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.

Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency
Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters (MOP/SOP/EOP review, RCAs, FMEAs, change governance, and risk mitigation)
Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters
Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed
Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs)
Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio

Provides mentorship across data centers for specific expertise.
Seeks training opportunities that meet the interest of the business as well as own career goals and objectives.

Suggests improvements in implementation based on depth of understanding.
Contributes to a positive team environment by learning and adopting best practices.
Contributes constructively during team meetings and in cross-disciplinary collaborations within the service team.

Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

Microsoft-1970393556979471.title: Dir Architecture
Microsoft-1970393556979471.description:
Overview
Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their outstanding each day. Growth mindset encourages each of us to lean in and learn what matters most to our customers, to create the foundational knowledge that enables us to make customer-first decisions in everything we do. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.
Responsibilities
People Management
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
Model - Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
Architecture Design and Deployment
Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end-to-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Anticipates blockers and resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on good practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.
Practice Development
Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Anticipates and addresses organization- and industry-wide gaps, patterns, and needs to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. Leads and contributes to internal/external communities.
Trusted Advisor
Develops a deep network of internal/external relationships with senior-level decision makers at high-impact customers/partners to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. Provides guidance to others in doing so. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
Coaches team to use evidence-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Leverages network and industry experience to connect customers/partners with ideas, people, and resources to support their success. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.
Drives awareness across all levels of the organization of partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy. Holds team accountable for leading the adoption of Microsoft technologies.
Thought Leadership
Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team at the corporate level. Holds teams across all organizational levels accountable for sharing insights with virtual team members, including C-level leaders, to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.
Initiates and drives external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons). Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Serves as an industry-leading expert and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences and publishing white papers around key technical topics and/or architecture design templates.
Other
Embody our culture and values

Microsoft-1970393557055731.title: Principal Software Engineer
Microsoft-1970393557055731.description:
Overview
Microsoft 365 Substrate is the shared data and intelligence platform behind Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot. It stores, indexes, secures and serves content for hundreds of millions of users across a global fleet, and it is the foundation on which search, semantic retrieval and AI experiences are built. Every email, file, message and permission change flows through the platform's storage, ingestion and propagation layers before customers can find and use it.
We are looking for engineers who want to build and run systems at this scale. In this role you will design, ship and operate core services across the Substrate stack: storage and data-access services, large-scale ingestion and propagation pipelines, search indexing and freshness, and the observability and repair systems that keep customer data correct and current. You will own production quality end to end, from architecture and code to deployment, on-call and continuous improvement.
The role is intentionally broad so that solid engineers can grow across the stack, with particular emphasis on Substrate storage. Engineers who bring deep storage and data-systems expertise will find significant room to shape how content is partitioned, scaled, repaired and served for Microsoft 365 workloads.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design, build and operate highly available distributed services on the Substrate platform, with clear ownership for reliability, performance, security and cost.
Evolve storage and data-access services, including client SDKs and APIs, migration from legacy access paths to supported clients, and correctness guarantees for reads, writes, deletes and queries.
Build and modernize large-scale ingestion and propagation pipelines, including event-driven processing, queueing, prioritization, retry, flow control and backpressure, so that content and permission changes reach downstream systems quickly and reliably.
Improve search freshness and completeness by tracing data end to end, detecting gaps, and building safe, replay-able and idempotent repair and backfill mechanisms.
Drive scale and capacity work across shards and stamps (groups of shards managed as a unit), including scale-out, scale-up, rebalancing, in-place repartitioning and approaches that avoid costly full re-crawls of source data.
Diagnose and mitigate production issues involving throttling, CPU, memory and disk pressure, hot spots, regional capacity constraints and cross-service dependencies, then deliver sustainable fixes.
Build observability: metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts and data-quality pipelines that distinguish real customer impact from reporting gaps.
Raise engineering quality through design reviews, automated and functional testing, safe flighting and rollback, and reduction of test flakiness and toil.
Apply automation and AI-assisted tooling to incident triage, diagnostics and routine operations.
Partner with service teams across regions and time zones to plan milestones, onboard new workloads and land cross-team architectural changes.
Microsoft-1970393557055731.requirements:
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience for Senior, and 8+ years for Principal, building and shipping backend or infrastructure software. Equivalent demonstrated impact is considered.
Solid coding skills in at least one systems or backend language such as C#, C++, Java, Go or Rust. Experience with C# and .NET is especially relevant; equivalent experience transfers well.
Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking and operating systems.
Experience designing and operating distributed systems or cloud services, including reasoning about failure modes, consistency, latency and throughput.
Experience designing APIs or SDKs, writing testable code and building automated tests at unit, integration and end-to-end levels.
Experience running production services, including participation in on-call rotations, incident response and root-cause analysis.
Clear written and verbal communication in English, including design documents and status updates for technical and leadership audiences.
8+ years building large-scale distributed storage, database, search or messaging systems (Principal), or 5+ years with significant ownership in one of these areas (Senior).
Hands-on experience with storage engines, distributed file or object stores, key-value stores, or search engines such as Lucene-based systems.
Experience operating services at the scale of millions of tenants or billions of items, including multi-region and sovereign-cloud deployments.
Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange, SharePoint or OneDrive back ends, or with Azure Storage, Cosmos DB or similar platforms.
Experience leading a major migration, re-architecture or modernization of a production system with no customer-visible disruption.
Track record of publications, patents, open-source contributions or internal technical talks in distributed systems or storage.
#CAP #M365

Overview
Microsoft 365 Substrate is the shared data and intelligence platform behind Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot. It stores, indexes, secures and serves content for hundreds of millions of users across a global fleet, and it is the foundation on which search, semantic retrieval and AI experiences are built. Every email, file, message and permission change flows through the platform's storage, ingestion and propagation layers before customers can find and use it.
We are looking for engineers who want to build and run systems at this scale. In this role you will design, ship and operate core services across the Substrate stack: storage and data-access services, large-scale ingestion and propagation pipelines, search indexing and freshness, and the observability and repair systems that keep customer data correct and current. You will own production quality end to end, from architecture and code to deployment, on-call and continuous improvement.
The role is intentionally broad so that solid engineers can grow across the stack, with particular emphasis on Substrate storage. Engineers who bring deep storage and data-systems expertise will find significant room to shape how content is partitioned, scaled, repaired and served for Microsoft 365 workloads.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design, build and operate highly available distributed services on the Substrate platform, with clear ownership for reliability, performance, security and cost.
Evolve storage and data-access services, including client SDKs and APIs, migration from legacy access paths to supported clients, and correctness guarantees for reads, writes, deletes and queries.
Build and modernize large-scale ingestion and propagation pipelines, including event-driven processing, queueing, prioritization, retry, flow control and backpressure, so that content and permission changes reach downstream systems quickly and reliably.
Improve search freshness and completeness by tracing data end to end, detecting gaps, and building safe, replay-able and idempotent repair and backfill mechanisms.
Drive scale and capacity work across shards and stamps (groups of shards managed as a unit), including scale-out, scale-up, rebalancing, in-place repartitioning and approaches that avoid costly full re-crawls of source data.
Diagnose and mitigate production issues involving throttling, CPU, memory and disk pressure, hot spots, regional capacity constraints and cross-service dependencies, then deliver sustainable fixes.
Build observability: metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts and data-quality pipelines that distinguish real customer impact from reporting gaps.
Raise engineering quality through design reviews, automated and functional testing, safe flighting and rollback, and reduction of test flakiness and toil.
Apply automation and AI-assisted tooling to incident triage, diagnostics and routine operations.
Partner with service teams across regions and time zones to plan milestones, onboard new workloads and land cross-team architectural changes.

Microsoft-1970393557042170.title: Principal Software Engineer - M365
Microsoft-1970393557042170.description:
Overview
Microsoft 365 and Copilot operate at extraordinary scale, and behind them is Substrate & Work IQ (SWIQ), the trusted data and intelligence foundation that helps Microsoft understand, operate, and continuously improve some of its largest cloud services. SWIQ connects product experiences, infrastructure, operations, and business outcomes to power service health, operational excellence, business insights, and AI-driven decision-making.
The SWIQ Performance Team is looking for a
Principal Software Engineer
to tackle some of the most challenging performance and efficiency problems across Microsoft 365 and Copilot. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable, and efficient experiences at global scale while building the intelligence and engineering systems needed to sustain continued growth.
This is not a narrowly scoped performance role. You will work across software, infrastructure, data, and AI to identify and solve high-leverage problems in latency, scalability, reliability, resource efficiency, telemetry, cost optimization, infrastructure demand, benchmarking, and platform health. You will influence where we optimize software, evolve architecture, change operating models, and invest in the platform.
Success requires more than technical depth. You will need to navigate ambiguity, connect signals across complex systems, understand customer and business impact, and turn insights into clear engineering decisions and measurable outcomes.
This is also an AI-first engineering role. You will use agents, automation, AIOps, AI-driven analysis, evaluation systems, and rapid prototyping to reason across telemetry, explore tradeoffs, identify opportunities, and accelerate decisions. Just as importantly, you will help shape how engineering itself evolves, building more scalable and AI-forward ways to understand and operate complex systems.
You will partner with engineering and product leaders, architects, data scientists, finance, service owners, and teams across Microsoft 365. The role offers broad visibility and influence for an engineering leader who wants to shape systems, drive cross-organizational execution, and make a measurable difference at Microsoft 365 and Copilot scale.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Set technical direction and architecture
for performance, scalability, reliability, and strategic efficiency across Microsoft 365 and Copilot, connecting customer experience, platform health, resource consumption, and long-term system evolution.
Own complex, ambiguous problems end to end
, from deep technical investigation and architecture through implementation, production rollout, measurement, and sustained results, especially for problems spanning multiple services and organizations.
Lead cross-organizational engineering efforts and architectural decisions
, balancing performance, reliability, scalability, resource efficiency, operational complexity, engineering velocity, and customer impact while influencing teams beyond direct ownership.
Build reusable platform capabilities and technical leverage
, turning recurring problems and successful solutions into shared architectures, frameworks, APIs, automation, tools, and engineering patterns that benefit multiple teams.
Use deep systems understanding and data to drive engineering decisions
, applying telemetry, profiling, benchmarking, experimentation, prototypes, evaluation frameworks, and production signals to identify root causes, quantify opportunities, and make informed technical tradeoffs.
Lead the design and implementation of high-impact engineering solutions
across latency reduction, infrastructure demand reduction, telemetry efficiency, resource utilization, reliability, cost efficiency, and scalable service operation.
Build and apply agents, automation, AIOps, and AI-driven engineering systems
to connect telemetry and operational data, investigate issues, evaluate solutions, automate remediation, and transform manual engineering processes into intelligent, scalable systems.
Raise the engineering bar across the organization
through architecture leadership, design and code reviews, engineering standards, technical communication, reusable practices, and mentoring and developing senior engineers and technical leaders.

Microsoft-1970393557047245.title: Principal Software Engineer - M365 - Copilot
Microsoft-1970393557047245.description:
Overview
Microsoft Office helps people and organizations around the world create, communicate, analyze, and get work done. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and OneNote serve a vast and diverse customer base, creating a unique opportunity to bring AI capabilities into the tools people already rely on every day.
As a Principal Software Engineer on the Office AI team in the Office Product Group, you will define and build the AI foundation that empowers all Office apps.
You will set technical direction for shared systems that connect AI models with app capabilities and customer context—turning advances in AI into useful, trustworthy, and high-quality capabilities at Office scale. With the Office app teams, you will co-define user experiences that feel natural in each app while meeting Microsoft's expectations for reliability, performance, privacy, security, and accessibility.
This role calls for both technical vision and hands-on delivery. You will turn ambiguous opportunities into clear architectures and plans, then help teams deliver the designs, documentation, and production software needed to realize them. You will measure outcomes in shipped capabilities and customer impact, not just proposals.
Lead through technical judgment and example: mentor engineers, grow engineering practices, and align teams around clear architectures and measurable outcomes.
Responsibilities
Define and drive the technical strategy and shared foundation that empower AI-powered experiences across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, and other Office apps.
Design architectures for scalable services and client capabilities that Office app teams can build on to bring AI into their workflows, from individual features to cross-app experiences.
Lead implementation of grounded, context-aware AI systems, including orchestration, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, and feedback loops as appropriate to the product.
Deliver concrete engineering outcomes: architecture designs, clear technical specifications and decision documents, production-quality code, and reliable features operating in production.
Own technical execution from problem framing through launch and operation; identify risks early, make tradeoffs explicit, and use telemetry and customer feedback to guide improvements.
Balance quality, latency, cost, reliability, privacy, security, accessibility, and user control in product and platform decisions.
Set a high bar for engineering quality across design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and incident response.
Partner with product managers, designers, researchers, and Office app teams to co-define cohesive, app-specific user experiences and influence shared technical investments.

Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and operating production software for cloud services, client platforms, or both.
Experience delivering commercial-grade customer-facing products with high standards for availability, performance, reliability, security, privacy, and accessibility.
A track record of leading complex, multi-team technical efforts from architecture through implementation, launch, and sustained operation.
Demonstrated ability to turn technical direction into tangible results, including architecture designs, clear technical specifications and decision documents, and production software.

Strong communication and cross-discipline collaboration skills, including the ability to influence technical direction across Office app teams and organizational boundaries.

7+ years of experience building commercial-grade software, including mission-critical, large-scale, high-availability services or client platforms.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and architecture for distributed systems, reusable platforms, or cross-app capabilities spanning multiple services, platforms, or engineering teams.
Experience owning ambiguous engineering problems end to end, from investigation and architecture through implementation, production launch, measurement, and sustained operation.
Deep expertise in performance, scalability, reliability, and efficiency engineering, using telemetry, profiling, benchmarking, experimentation, or production diagnostics to guide decisions and measurable improvements.
Demonstrated ability to create technical leverage through shared frameworks, APIs, tools, automation, and engineering patterns that help Office app teams build cohesive, app-specific AI experiences.
Experience with large-scale AI-powered products, including grounding, orchestration, evaluation, reliability, privacy, or cost considerations.
Experience applying agents, automation, or AI-driven analysis to improve product experiences or engineering workflows, with sound responsible AI practices.
Demonstrated technical leadership across disciplines, including architectural alignment, engineering standards, clear technical communication, and mentoring senior engineers.
