Microsoft-1970393557041458.title: Principal Software Engineer--M365 Deployment Team
Microsoft-1970393557041458.description:
Overview
We are looking for a
Principal Software Engineer
to help define and drive the next generation of Microsoft's large-scale deployment platform.
Our team is undertaking a fundamental transformation of how cloud services are deployed and operated. We are modernizing today's deployment architecture while evolving toward an
AI-native engineering model
, where deployment systems are no longer designed primarily for human operators. Instead,
humans and AI agents will be first-class participants
, capable of reasoning, acting, collaborating, and safely operating services at cloud scale.
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will help define the architecture of this next-generation deployment platform. You will establish the capabilities, APIs, abstractions, observability, controls, and safety boundaries required for both humans and AI agents to interact with the platform effectively. You will also drive the application of AI and agent technologies to automate increasingly complex deployment and operational workflows.
You will tackle highly ambiguous problems spanning multiple systems and organizations, translate long-term vision into practical architecture and execution, and multiply the impact of the broader engineering team through technical leadership, mentorship, and engineering excellence.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Define the technical vision, architecture, and long-term strategy for key areas of our next-generation deployment platform.
Lead the transformation from a primarily human-centric deployment system toward an AI-native platform where humans and AI agents are first-class participants.
Define the platform capabilities, APIs, abstractions, telemetry, control mechanisms, and safety boundaries that enable agents to reason, act, collaborate, and autonomously execute deployment workflows at scale.
Drive the application of AI and agent technologies across deployment, validation, troubleshooting, mitigation, recovery, and other engineering workflows.
Lead architecture and design for complex distributed systems operating across large-scale Microsoft cloud infrastructure.
Drive modernization toward more modular, independently evolvable, scalable, observable, and resilient deployment architecture.
Tackle the team's hardest and most ambiguous technical challenges, identify systemic architectural issues, and create durable solutions that extend beyond individual features.
Establish engineering principles and standards for reliability, security, observability, scalability, quality, and operational excellence.
Drive technical alignment across organizational boundaries and resolve complex architecture, dependency, and ownership challenges.

Microsoft-1970393557007807.description:
Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated
Principal Software Engineer
who is passionate about building intelligent, scalable, and resilient systems at the heart of Microsoft 365’s infrastructure. You will join the M365 Networking team, building routing, traffic-management, and load-balancing capabilities that help deliver reliable, efficient, and secure connectivity for Microsoft 365 workloads, including Copilot, Teams, and SharePoint Online.
About the Team
The M365 Networking team focuses on connecting requests to the right service endpoints across Microsoft 365’s global infrastructure. Our work spans routing, traffic management, and load balancing to improve service availability, minimize latency, and efficiently utilize capacity. We tackle distributed-systems challenges at massive scale, with a focus on technical excellence, innovation, and operational impact.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Design and implement routing, traffic-management, and load-balancing capabilities to support scenarios across M365, including Copilot.
Optimize traffic distribution based on service health and available capacity to improve performance, resilience, and resource utilization.
Build distributed, highly available, and resilient systems.
Work with services spanning thousands of servers, processing tens of billions of transactions, and serving hundreds of millions of users.
Drive technical excellence through code reviews, architecture design.

Microsoft-1970393557007921.title: Principal Software Engineer--M365 Work IQ
Microsoft-1970393557007921.description:
Overview
Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s workplace intelligence layer, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first interfaces including REST APIs, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, CLI tooling, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling developers to build intelligent, enterprise-aware agents and applications.
We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot Extensibility Engineering team, are looking for a Principal Software Engineer for Work IQ whose primary engineering focus is building the intelligence platform that connects AI agents to Microsoft 365 knowledge. You will own the design and development of Work IQ's REST and A2A APIs, MCP infrastructure, retrieval and orchestration services, and developer tooling. Your work will shape how agents access, reason over, and act on enterprise knowledge, helping establish Work IQ as the foundation for the next generation of Microsoft 365 Copilot and agent experiences.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Take ownership of critical product and platform areas of the Work IQ API and related agentic components.
Set a high technical and quality bar for agentic systems and developer-facing tooling.
Design and ship performant, reliable terminal experiences that developers depend on for daily work.
Use data, benchmarks, and direct user feedback to guide iteration and investment.
Collaborate across org boundaries to enable other teams to build agentic products on top of a shared foundation.
Influence architecture, technical direction, and engineering standards beyond your immediate team.

Microsoft-1970393556982284.title: Researcher
Microsoft-1970393556982284.description:
Overview
Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential - and excitement for the journey ahead.
As Researcher, you will conduct research and leads research collaborations that yield new insights, theories, analyses, data, algorithms, and/or prototypes that advance the state-of-the-art of computer science and engineering, as well as general scientific knowledge. Formulates research problems in an area of study and initiates the design, development, execution, and implementation of a research agenda to further academic knowledge and close identified gaps. Provides expertise to product or business groups and may create long-term business opportunities through research outcomes, but not responsible for addressing immediate product needs or demonstrating a clear path to product.
We are seeking candidates excelling in deep thinking research aspects and fast-paced entrepreneurial execution. The ideal candidates should have the ability to work with researchers and product team colleagues at Microsoft to push forward research agendas, being a team player in a collaborative and supportive environment with outstanding programming skills. We are seeking candidates with research skills and technical backgrounds. Applicants should demonstrate depth of knowledge in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Systems and Networking, Natural Language Understanding, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, as well as academia experience in advance the state of art of research.
Microsoft works with the world's best researchers, moving with the current of technology as it rapidly evolves. Together we share the motivation to seek innovative solutions to the world's toughest challenges and improve the lives of people everywhere. Microsoft provides a nurturing environment to support passionate researchers and engineers in AI technology innovation.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Collaborates with product and business groups to provide expertise and technology, participates in technology transfer, files patents, authors white papers, and develops tools/services for internal use. May publish research.
Bridges the gap between researchers and development teams, bringing new technology and approaches into production to solve immediate product needs. Identifies and applies research-backed solutions to positively impact Microsoft products or services.
Gains expertise in specific research subareas and broad research fields, applies advanced concepts to product needs, and consults with engineers and product teams. Researches tools and methods to improve product quality, performance, or efficiency.
Reviews and prepares data for analysis, ensuring quality and technical constraints are met. Develops usable datasets for modeling, adapts cleaned data for machine learning, and designs ETL pipelines. Collaborates to apply state-of-the-art algorithms to business problems and uses statistical tools to evaluate machine learning models.
Supports the application and deployment of machine learning algorithms, seeks information to improve models, and helps create, apply, and verify models through iterations. Assists with experiments and sets up monitoring to track production models.
Documents work in progress, experimentation results, and plans to ensure processes are captured, participates in creating informal documentation, shares findings to promote innovation, and follows ethics and privacy policies when executing research processes or collecting data.

Microsoft-1970393557041467.title: Senior Software Engineer - M365
Microsoft-1970393557041467.description:
Overview

With continued growth in digital advertising and the desire to serve advertisers from all over the world, Microsoft Ads Billing team is growing to meet new challenges and providing excellent billing experiences for global advertisers! The Ads Billing team is hiring experienced engineers to join agile and diverse engineering teams in Micro Services, Platform Development and AI powered tools/agents/MCPs.
As a Senior Software Engineer in Ads Billing team, you will work closely with PM to address worldwide advertiser's voices, implement services with global access, collect and protect Bing Ads revenue for Microsoft.  This opportunity will allow you to learn and develop deep business acumen in digital ads area, learn/explore/innovate/build cutting edge AI knowledges/techs/tools to serve our systems and end customers, sharpen your system developing skills, accelerate your career growth.

Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for product, application, service and platform.
Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI).
Leverages subject-matter expertise of product features and partners with stakeholders to drive a workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items.
Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and work with team members by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate.
Set a high technical and quality bar for agentic systems and developer-facing tooling.
Design and ship performant, reliable terminal experiences that developers depend on for daily work.
Use data, benchmarks, and direct user feedback to guide iteration and investment
Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of Billing system while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale.

Microsoft 365 IC3 Data Platform builds governed data infrastructure for large-scale communication and collaboration scenarios. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Suzhou or Shanghai to make data easier to discover, understand, and operate.
You will connect data assets, source code, and operational signals to help engineers understand where data comes from, how it is used, and what changes may affect. We welcome backgrounds in data platforms, data catalog, data preview, data lineage/tracing, or repository analysis. Experience in all these areas is not required; strong software engineering fundamentals and production delivery experience are essential.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Leverage AI or traditional backend service to do repo/dataset analysis and collect metadata information.
Build data catalog, data preview, data lineage along with data quality features for the whole IC3.
Understand data regulations and implement above functionalities with a compliant way.
Improve reliability and performance through testing, telemetry, and production troubleshooting.
Collaborate across teams and contribute to design and code reviews to deliver maintainable solutions.

Microsoft-1970393557041449.title: Senior Software Engineer--M365 Directory team
Microsoft-1970393557041449.description:
Overview
Do you want to help modernize one of the foundational platforms behind Microsoft 365? The Directory team is undertaking a multi-year transformation to build the next generation of Microsoft 365 directory infrastructure.
Directory Modernization is redesigning directory storage, APIs, synchronization, caching, and traffic-management systems to eliminate legacy Active Directory dependencies and enable a secure, scalable, reliable, and cloud-native architecture. This work involves transitioning business-critical data and traffic to modern systems without disrupting existing services or customers. It presents challenging engineering problems across distributed data systems, service architecture, data consistency, high availability, performance, security, and large-scale migration.
We are looking for a
Senior Software Engineer
to own the design and delivery of key capabilities within Directory Modernization. In this role, you will solve complex and ambiguous technical problems, design extensible distributed systems, and collaborate with engineers and partner teams across Microsoft. You will have the opportunity to influence technical direction, improve engineering and operational excellence, mentor other engineers, and deliver foundational capabilities used by Microsoft 365 services.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities

Microsoft Research Asia Pacific (MSR Asia), established in 1998, is a leading research lab with major sites in Beijing and Shanghai. Over the years, technologies developed by MSR Asia have made a significant impact within Microsoft and also around the world, and new, innovative technologies are constantly being born from the lab.
Microsoft Research Asia (MSRA) is now looking for a Senior Researcher specializing in AI with a strong focus on Large Language Model, Agentic AI Systems, AI Infrastructure, Multimodality, Embodied AI, and related fields
.
This is an exceptional opportunity to drive an ambitious research agenda while collaborating with diverse teams to push for novel applications of those research areas.

Microsoft-1970393557022790.title: Service Engineer 2(Microsoft Advertising)
Microsoft-1970393557022790.description:
Overview
Make Microsoft Advertising part of your career story. Microsoft Advertising supports advertisers and partners across search, audience, retail media, commerce, and emerging AI-powered experiences, helping businesses connect with customers across the Microsoft ecosystem. Global Support is a critical partner to customers, sales, product, policy, and engineering teams, ensuring advertisers can use Microsoft Advertising with confidence while keeping the marketplace safe and trustworthy for users. As a Service Engineer focused on editorial appeals, fraud, and complaints, you will investigate complex ad disapprovals, account suspensions, suspected fraud and abuse, and customer and third-party complaints, using telemetry, data analysis, policy expertise, automation, and AI-assisted tools to reach accurate, well-evidenced outcomes. You will partner closely with engineering, policy, and business stakeholders to turn customer signals into product improvements, clearer policy guidance, scalable processes, and smarter detection. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical curiosity, strong judgement, customer empathy, and a commitment to integrity in a fast-moving digital advertising environment.
Responsibilities
Investigate and resolve complex editorial appeals for disapproved ads, keywords, landing pages, and domains, using policy guidelines, telemetry, landing-page evidence, and platform diagnostics to reach accurate, consistent, and defensible outcomes.
Investigate suspected fraud and abuse, including account suspensions, compromised accounts, payment fraud, invalid traffic, and policy circumvention, ensuring legitimate advertisers are restored quickly while bad actors are kept off the platform.
Own the end-to-end handling of customer, partner, and third-party complaints, including trademark, intellectual property, and harmful or misleading advertising complaints, ensuring timely resolution in line with legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements.
Own complex customer, partner, sales, and support escalations by balancing urgency, quality, business impact, SLA expectations, and policy integrity while keeping stakeholders informed through clear and timely communication.
Apply an automation-first mindset to identify repeatable manual work, recurring appeal, fraud, and complaint patterns, and high-volume scenarios that can be simplified, standardized, scripted, or automated.
Design, improve, and maintain automation, dashboards, proactive checks, alerting signals, and AI-assisted tools that accelerate triage, improve decision consistency, and reduce manual review effort.
Use data and insights to detect trends, prevent fraud and abuse, protect advertiser ROI, and ensure user safety across the Microsoft Advertising ecosystem.
Drive root cause analysis of incorrect enforcement decisions, detection gaps, and recurring complaint themes in partnership with Product, Engineering, and Policy teams, ensuring fixes and improvements are prioritized, validated, and landed effectively.
Translate customer and support signals into actionable product feedback, high-quality bugs, policy clarification requests, detection improvements, and business-impact summaries.
Create and maintain scalable support assets, including appeal and complaint playbooks, investigation guides, knowledge base articles, escalation templates, and readiness content.
Support the rollout of new policies, enforcement capabilities, fraud controls, and platform features through readiness reviews, launch validation, workflow testing, and post-release monitoring.
Measure and improve effectiveness through indicators such as appeal turnaround time, decision accuracy, complaint resolution time, fewer repeat contacts, SLA stability, and improved customer support quality.
Participate in operational coverage, including occasional night and weekend on-call support, to maintain service health and timely response to critical escalations.
Microsoft-1970393557022790.requirements:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related technical field, or equivalent technical experience.
3+ years of technical experience in service engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, technical support, trust and safety, or a comparable environment supporting online services, commercial platforms, or cloud services.
5+ years of hands-on experience in China’s domestic Internet advertising industry in advertising review or review operations (such as advertiser and license review, advertising content review, appeals handling, policy enforcement, or advertising compliance), with a documented record of high-quality, accurate, and impactful results.
Proficiency in China’s Internet advertising regulatory compliance requirements and their execution, including the Advertising Law of the PRC and the Measures for the Administration of Internet Advertising; licensing and documentation requirements; platform obligations (illegal-ad monitoring, advertiser identity and record retention, complaint handling); the distinction between statutory pre-publication ad review for regulated categories and platform ad review under internal policy; and government-escalation processes.
Experience in customer-facing Tier 3 technical support, escalation management, content or ad review, policy enforcement, or fraud investigation for high-volume online platforms.
Experience investigating fraud, abuse, invalid traffic, account compromise, or payment risk, and familiarity with common fraud patterns and detection approaches.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Mandarin and English, with the ability to explain adjustment decisions and complex technical findings clearly and empathetically to customers, partners, engineering teams, and leadership stakeholders.
Sound judgement, integrity, and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential cases, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous situations with strong ownership.
Experience designing, building, or improving automation, scripts, diagnostic workflows, dashboards, or alerting solutions that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency with one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, C#, JavaScript, PowerShell, or similar languages used for automation, tooling, data analysis, or troubleshooting.
Experience querying, analyzing, and visualizing large datasets using SQL or equivalent data platforms to identify trends, validate hypotheses, and generate actionable insights.
Experience using AI-assisted tools, machine learning signals, or emerging automation capabilities to improve triage, investigation, summarization, or decision quality.
Experience handling formal complaints or regulatory requests, with working knowledge of relevant frameworks such as the EU Digital Services Act, GDPR, consumer protection, or intellectual property regulations.
Ability to collaborate across remote, global, and cross-functional teams and influence through evidence.
Experience with Microsoft Advertising, ad tech, search, digital advertising policy, trust and safety, or fraud prevention preferred.

Microsoft-1970393557052854.title: Software Engineer 2 - M365 Core
Microsoft-1970393557052854.description:
Overview
Microsoft 365 and Copilot rely on some of the world's largest telemetry and data platforms. Every day, massive amounts of data flow through Azure Storage, Cosmos, and Blueshift to power engineering insights, reliability monitoring, performance analysis, and operational decision making across Microsoft's cloud services.
The SWIQ Performance team is focused on making these platforms more efficient, scalable, and cost effective. We partner with engineering teams across Microsoft 365 to reduce infrastructure costs, improve resource utilization, and simplify operations through automation and intelligent tooling.
We're looking for an engineer who enjoys digging into large-scale systems, finding opportunities hidden in data, and turning ideas into production solutions. In this role, you'll work on challenges such as storage optimization, capacity reduction, telemetry platform efficiency, and AI-native transformation. You'll have the opportunity to see your work translate directly into meaningful improvements in platform efficiency and operational cost savings.
This is a great opportunity to learn how Microsoft runs large-scale cloud services while developing expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, big data platforms, and emerging AI technologies.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Build services, tools, and automation that improve the efficiency and reliability of large-scale telemetry and data platforms.
Investigate storage and compute optimization opportunities across Azure Storage, Cosmos, and Blueshift and help drive them into production.
Develop dashboards, analytics, and recommendation tooling that help engineers understand usage patterns and identify savings opportunities.
Work with partner teams to validate opportunities, implement improvements, and measure business impact.
Apply AI-assisted engineering tools and automation to improve investigations, analysis, and operational workflows.
Contribute to system design, implementation, testing, monitoring, and ongoing service improvements.

Microsoft-1970393557007864.title: Software Engineer 2--M365 UIPilot team
Microsoft-1970393557007864.description:
Overview
The UIPilot team at Microsoft builds an AI-powered computer-use platform that enables agents to interact with software and carry out tasks across applications and operating systems. We combine AI, cross-platform interaction, and cloud infrastructure to translate human intent into reliable execution—from individual actions to complex, multi-step workflows.
As a Software Engineer on the UIPilot team, you will build capabilities across agent planning and reasoning, application interaction, execution orchestration, and failure recovery. You will help make computer-use agents more capable, reliable, and scalable, enabling scenarios spanning productivity, workflow automation, and software validation.
We are looking for hands-on engineers with strong ownership, curiosity, and critical thinking. You should enjoy using AI to build software, exploring unfamiliar systems, and investigating problems deeply—while applying independent judgment and validating conclusions with evidence.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Advance AI-powered computer use: Develop agent capabilities for planning, interacting with applications, evaluating outcomes, and recovering from failures across web and desktop environments.
Build scalable platform capabilities: Design and deliver backend services, APIs, execution orchestration, and user-facing tools that support scenario onboarding and reliable execution across applications and operating systems.
Strengthen reliability and diagnosability: Investigate issues across AI behavior, agent execution, application interactions, and cloud infrastructure.
Establish root causes and improve evaluation, observability, performance, and recovery mechanisms.
Accelerate engineering with AI: Use AI-powered coding agents throughout development and identify opportunities to integrate AI into engineering workflows.
Validate solutions for correctness, security, reliability, and measurable impact.
Own end-to-end engineering outcomes: Drive features from problem definition and technical design through implementation and production validation.
Make thoughtful trade-offs and apply strong code review, testing, documentation, and operational practices.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualifications:
Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
OR equivalent experience.
Solid ownership, curiosity, and critical thinking: Take responsibility for outcomes, seek to understand how systems work, and investigate beyond surface-level symptoms.
Question assumptions, consider alternative explanations, and validate hypotheses with evidence.
Follow through on resolution, collaborating and escalating when appropriate.
Proficiency with AI-powered coding agents: Effectively use agentic tools to explore codebases, plan and implement changes, generate tests, and investigate failures.
Recognize that AI-generated code and explanations may be incorrect or incomplete, and independently verify outputs through code inspection, testing, and runtime evidence.
Solid engineering fundamentals and troubleshooting skills: Build maintainable software using Python or another relevant language, with the ability to work effectively in a Python-based stack.
Understand APIs, automated testing, and service interactions, and reason clearly about system behavior and failure modes.
Independent execution and effective collaboration: Translate ambiguous problems into actionable plans, make sound technical judgments, and clearly communicate findings, decisions, risks, and next steps.
Experience building AI-powered agents, tool integrations, or computer-use capabilities, including planning, task evaluation, and execution recovery.
Familiarity with FastAPI, Playwright, Windows UI automation, or TypeScript/React.
Familiarity with iOS, Android, MacOS development and automation.
Experience with distributed execution, containers, Kubernetes/AKS, or Azure services, including CI/CD, observability, and production troubleshooting.

Microsoft-1970393557069743.title: Sr Solution Engineer--Security
Microsoft-1970393557069743.description:
Overview
Are you insatiably curious and do you lean into uncertainty, take risks, and learn quickly from? Are you passionate about cybersecurity? Do you enjoy working on a high-performing, fast-paced sales team? Are you insatiably curious and do you lean into uncertainty, take risks, and learn quickly from your mistakes? Are you ready to join the team that is at the leading edge of innovation at Microsoft?  If so, we are looking for you!
The Microsoft Security organization’s mission of making the world a safer place has never been more important. As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we must work to keep our customers safe through our Security Solutions. The Solution Specialist Unit team within the Microsoft Security organization is at the forefront of this effort, engaging directly with customers to contribute to their success. As the largest security company in the world, we are ideally placed to think outside the box to help our customers make the world a safer place.
As a Security Technical Specialist, you will be a senior technical sales leader and trusted customer advisor, working with cutting-edge security technologies such as Microsoft Defender for XDR and Sentinel. You will lead a v-team of other internal, partner and consulting resources to help map Microsoft solutions to customer security challenges and priorities, demonstrate and prove our solutions, and win the technical decision enabling the team to achieve/exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets. You will help solve complex security challenges for our customers, enabling them to help modernize their security architecture and posture.  This role is flexible in that you can work <up to 50% up to 100% from home>.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Primary technical point of contact for potential customers during the sales process, owing and driving technical win for security opportunities
Deep technical understanding of cloud security architectures, solutions/technologies including Microsoft M365 Defender, Defender for cloud and Sentinel and expertise in extended detection and response (XDR), zero trust and cloud security solutions and architectures
Remediate blockers; leads and ensures technical wins for Microsoft Security and adjacent technologies. Engages with and reaches out to customers proactively and independently; builds credibility with customers as a trusted advisor for Microsoft Security; and searches for and uses Microsoft Security customer references; and facilitates handoff to customer success for post sales deployment.
Develop strategies and recommendations to improve the client's security posture, shapes technical win plan and tailors Microsoft messaging to audience for security opportunities. Enhances team capabilities for extended detection and response (XDR), zero trust and cloud security and develops differentiated compete strategies for Microsoft Security for assigned customers.
Lead technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, architecture design sessions, explain, demonstrate, and architect the solution to help solve customer security challenges and priorities.
Drives cross-workload support for Microsoft solutions for security. Leverages insights and coaches' teams to align new or changing technology to customer security needs.
Responsible for engaging with other teams within and outside the organization throughout the sales cycle. Engaging partners in sell-with scenarios and supporting their technical capabilities is key to scaling solution delivery.

Microsoft-1970393557007550.title: Frontier Industry Advisor, Manufacturing and Mobility - China
Microsoft-1970393557007550.description:
Overview
AI-led transformation is reshaping every industry in the world. Across mobility and manufacturing, customers have moved beyond prioritizing individual AI use cases and are now deploying AI transformation at scale — reinventing how they design, build, move and service, with human-and-agent teams at the center of the operating model.
Microsoft Frontier Company is where that work happens. Frontier Company brings Microsoft’s deep industry expertise together with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) and our engineering studios into a single, agile motion that co-builds agentic solutions with our most strategic customers. Our Manufacturing & Mobility team leads that motion for the world’s automakers, suppliers and industrial manufacturers: defining each customer’s Frontier opportunity, shaping the business outcomes that matter, and driving them through to production. It is no longer about one software solution; it is about co-building a connected, secure, scalable agentic platform — and feeding what we learn back into Microsoft’s product roadmaps.
Our team culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. We also strive to have fun!
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
If you have a passion for customer success and want to be part of the greatest digital revolution, we want to hear from you
Responsibilities
The Industry Advisor (IA) is Microsoft Frontier Company’s senior industry voice in our most strategic mobility and manufacturing accounts. Operating at CxO level across a small number of pinned Strategic 500 (S500) customers, the IA is a genuine subject matter expert in the Mobility and Manufacturing industries and acts as the industry leader on a customer-centric account team — building the trust that allows Microsoft to co-build with the customer rather than sell to them.
The role owns the agentic-platform transformation end to end. The Industry Advisor defines the customer’s Frontier opportunity and the outcomes it will deliver, creates and qualifies the opportunity, and leads it through the Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) motion to customer value realization. The IA orchestrates; FDE and the Industry Studios build. Success is measured in delivered business outcomes and revenue in the assigned accounts, using Microsoft’s cloud, AI and data technologies — pipeline is a leading indicator, not the goal.
The role partners closely with the account team, the FDE and Industry Studio teams, the worldwide industry sales community and our partner ecosystem — reusing high-value agentic workflows across accounts and sharing customer references and case studies that bring Microsoft’s industry transformation stories to life.
Lead the agentic-platform transformation in assigned S500 accounts — define each customer’s Frontier opportunity, facilitate envisioning and ideation sessions, and develop multi-horizon roadmaps tied to measurable business outcomes.
Ignite, shape, and secure market-making business partnerships by building senior CxO and business-executive relationships and establishing a strong Microsoft footprint in each assigned account.
Drive account-based revenue by creating, qualifying and landing Frontier and FDE opportunities across the account, defining the industry plays that support them, and carrying them through to customer value realization.
Lead and orchestrate customer engagement in partnership with the account team and the FDE and Industry Studio teams — aligning early on business objectives, bringing FDE in as soon as an opportunity is identified, and moving engagements to triage-ready quickly.
Co-innovate from intake to production — prototype agentic solutions with the studios, then turn high-value workflows into reusable patterns, thought leadership and best practices that other accounts and colleagues can adopt.
Collaborate with the external partner ecosystem (e.g., business leaders, GSIs, ISVs) on client and partner planning and on industry-specific strategies that add credibility and depth.
Shape the buyer’s narrative and amplify thought leadership internally and externally — clarifying priorities and trade-offs, and building Microsoft’s Frontier credibility, brand and mindshare in the industry.
Embody Microsoft’s culture and values by modeling a growth mindset, operating with start-up agility, contributing to others’ success, and delivering impactful results that build on collective ideas and efforts.

Microsoft-1970393556962325.title: Account Executive - Auto
Microsoft-1970393556962325.description:
Overview
The Account Executive (AE) serves as the strategic business leader and trusted advisor for Microsoft’s automotive industry customers. This role is responsible for driving business growth, accelerating AI and cloud adoption, and developing long-term partnerships with leading automotive manufacturers, mobility providers, and intelligent transportation companies. The AE owns the overall customer strategy, executive relationships, and business outcomes while orchestrating cross-functional Microsoft and partner resources to support customers' digital transformation and innovation journeys.
Responsibilities
Customer Strategy & Executive Engagement
Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies aligned with customers' business priorities, technology roadmaps, and transformation objectives.
Build trusted relationships with C-level executives and key business stakeholders, including CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and innovation leaders.
Act as a strategic advisor by bringing industry insights, AI innovation, and digital transformation best practices to customers.
Business Growth & Revenue Accountability
Own and deliver against revenue, consumption, market share, and strategic growth targets.
Identify, develop, and close high-value opportunities across Azure, AI, Data, Security, Modern Work, and Industry Solutions.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline while driving predictable business performance and forecast accuracy.
Industry Leadership & Account Orchestration
Lead the account v-team and coordinate resources across ATS, CSAM, Solution Specialists, Solution Engineers, Commercial Executives, Customer Success, and Partners.
Drive customer planning, executive business reviews, and strategic account governance.
Ensure effective execution across all stages of the customer lifecycle.
Automotive Industry Transformation
Partner with automotive customers to accelerate software-defined vehicle (SDV), connected vehicle, autonomous driving, intelligent manufacturing, digital engineering, and AI transformation initiatives.
Help customers leverage Microsoft Cloud and AI capabilities to improve innovation speed, operational efficiency, product development, and business competitiveness.
Support customers' cloud migration, AI adoption, data platform modernization, and ecosystem collaboration strategies.
Customer Success & Long-Term Value Realization
Ensure successful realization of customer business outcomes and investment value.
Drive customer satisfaction, retention, strategic partnerships, and long-term account growth.
Collaborate closely with Customer Success teams to maximize solution adoption and business impact.
Microsoft-1970393556962325.requirements:
Experience
8+ years of enterprise sales, account management, business development, or consulting experience.
Proven track record of managing strategic enterprise accounts and delivering business growth.
Experience leading complex digital transformation, cloud, AI, or technology solution sales engagements.
Automotive industry experience is highly preferred, including OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, intelligent mobility companies, autonomous driving providers, EV manufacturers, or related ecosystems.
Industry & Business Acumen
Deep understanding of trends shaping the automotive industry, including electrification, intelligent vehicles, autonomous driving, software-defined vehicles, AI, and digital manufacturing.
Ability to connect business challenges with technology-driven solutions and measurable business outcomes.
Strong strategic thinking and commercial insight.
Leadership & Collaboration
Demonstrated ability to lead and influence diverse virtual teams without direct authority.
Excellent stakeholder management, executive engagement, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Strong program orchestration and resource management capabilities.
Communication & Executive Presence
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive engagement skills.
Proven ability to engage senior business and technology decision-makers.
Strong consultative selling, value-based selling, and solution-selling capabilities.

Microsoft-1970393557030101.title: Account Executive - MBA
Microsoft-1970393557030101.description:
Overview
Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential - and excitement for the journey ahead.
As an Account Executive,  you will build trust and credibility with executives, decision makers to address business and technical needs; Develops a comprehensive understanding of customer industry and identifies opportunities to drive optimization and digitalization solutions; Initiates conversations with customers on digital transformation; Coordinates with extended virtual teams and holds team accountable for executing customer needs; Sets priorities, focus, and resources and strengthens operations, ensuring that the extended virtual team and other stakeholders are working toward common goals; Plans ahead to determine order of priority for action on accounts based on customer needs, sales-generating importance, growth opportunity and assessment of risks.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Engages with internal and external stakeholders on account planning for assigned accounts and sets strategic priorities and plan to achieve outcomes. Structures and leads account planning rhythm to set priorities, aligns Solutions/Sales Plays and opportunities, partners, focus, and resources to regularly update the plan, ensuring that the extended virtual team (inclusive of partners) and other stakeholders are working toward common goals. Ensures teams are documenting in the Account Plan.
Builds and maintains a network of internal (e.g., Industry Solutions [IS]) and external partners to drive opportunities and influence impact for multiple assigned accounts. Leverages relationship with partners to develop and share customer business and technology transformation plans that support mutual needs. Where applicable, shares opportunities outbound with partners, and reviews/accepts opportunities shared inbound. Proactively engages and works with partners’ sellers directly to drive non-qualified opportunity momentum and deal closure inclusive of partners.
Manages and executes plans utilizing common sales and delivery methodology for the Microsoft sales organization for multiple accounts to ensure Microsoft targets and customer business needs are met. Coordinates with extended virtual teams and holds self and the team accountable for executing on plans and meeting customer needs. Outlines revenue targets to deliver on account plans. Orchestrates extended team and embraces partners to scale business. Ensures achievement of revenue and consumption targets and drives integrated joint account governance through customer plan on regular frequency. Identifies initial stakeholders, customer needs, and customer priorities. Proposes initial Solutions/Sales Plays.
Develops a strong understanding of the customer's business and technology needs and the needs of each assigned account. Identifies opportunities to drive optimizations and new business and technology solutions/ideas based on their needs and strategies. Works on behalf of the customer. If industry aligned, also develops an understanding of the customer's industry.
Builds and maintains relationship with executives and business and technical decision makers at high levels of the customer's organization through consultative engagement to establish trust and credibility in future interactions. Continues to build reputation with customers during interactions by being customer-focused, consistently honoring commitments, explaining technical concepts relevant to the customer, and connecting the customer to Microsoft executives. Leverages selling methods (e.g., digital) to network and create a pipeline, consume account-based marketing outputs, and reflect the engagement strategy in our customer plan.
Understands customer drivers of business transformation and contributes to technology/transformation with the customer. Initiates conversations with customers on digital transformation for assigned accounts. Mitigates competitive risk. Ensures line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., testimonials) for referencing through insightful listening.
Seeks customer feedback (both formal and informal) of assigned accounts to identify and understand the drivers of satisfaction and/or dissatisfaction. Leverages internal resources to support customer needs. Orchestrates others (e.g., Customer Success Account Management [CSAM]) to anticipate issues/risks on customer satisfaction, determine the root cause of problems, remove blockers, and establish recovery action plans as need to improve customers' overall experience. Proactively establishes agreement on success measures and manages execution on success measures to prevent need for recovery plans.

Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential - and excitement for the journey ahead.
As an Account Executive,  you will build trust and credibility with executives, decision makers to address business and technical needs; Develops a comprehensive understanding of customer industry and identifies opportunities to drive optimization and digitalization solutions; Initiates conversations with customers on digital transformation; Coordinates with extended virtual teams and holds team accountable for executing customer needs; Sets priorities, focus, and resources and strengthens operations, ensuring that the extended virtual team and other stakeholders are working toward common goals; Plans ahead to determine order of priority for action on accounts based on customer needs, sales-generating importance, growth opportunity and assessment of risks.

Structures and leads account planning rhythm to set priorities, aligns Solutions/Sales Plays and opportunities, partners, focus, and resources to regularly update the plan, ensuring that the extended virtual team (inclusive of partners) and other stakeholders are working toward common goals. Proactively engages and works with partners’ sellers directly to drive non-qualified opportunity momentum and deal closure inclusive of partners.
Manages and executes plans utilizing common sales and delivery methodology for the Microsoft sales organization for multiple accounts to ensure Microsoft targets and customer business needs are met. Ensures line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., testimonials) for referencing through insightful listening.
Seeks customer feedback (both formal and informal) of assigned accounts to identify and understand the drivers of satisfaction and/or dissatisfaction. Leverages internal resources to support customer needs. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Generates business insights based on data received from the customer and internal teams (e.g., community and ecosystem, account team), and from knowledge of the capability of Microsoft products, to provide input into planning processes. Orchestrates resources on behalf of the customer, partner, and the account team unit, under guidance. Identifies the right customer stakeholders for the technical teams to engage.
Develops expertise in customer businesses. technology platforms, to support the digital technology strategy with the customer that is aligned to business outcomes. Challenges customers’ assumptions with constructive dialogue about their business and technology.
Researches customer organizations and connects with technical decision makers (TDMs) under guidance. Supports conversations with enterprise customers that present the strategic relationship between Microsoft technologies, products, and services compared with the competitor's solution and the customer's overall business goals and objectives.
Povides support to help drive account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates account teams and conducts forecasting and tracking of the business, as instructed. Execute tasks related to the technical portion of the customer plans.
Presents the AI and Industrial Metaverse themes to technical decision maker (TDM) stakeholders within the customer to create interest and excitement about Microsoft's capabilities in those areas. Creates the resulting opportunities and introduces the appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) to pursue.

Assists in the creation of fundamental, technology roadmaps, outlining the customer's transformation journey and core wins, with help from others. Builds technical engagement or enablement plan, captures baseline, and drives envisioning. Applies an understanding of the customer's business objectives and scenarios in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays.

Microsoft-1970393557056265.title: Account Technology Strategist
Microsoft-1970393557056265.description:
Overview
Generates innovative business insights, orchestrates teams to develop insights, and applies expertise in customer business in alignment with customer goals. Acts as the "Virtual Technical Officer", provides technical guidance to teams, builds and maintains strong industry and client knowledge, and acts as the voice of the customer. Creates mid- to long-term digital transformation roadmaps while ensuring execution of technological strategy, providing analysis of customer needs, and translating the customer business objectives to develop technology architecture. Leads industry and digital transformation acceleration to identify, create demand, and deliver customer solutions. Drives new opportunities, leads internal teams to accelerate customer digital transformation, and drive conversations regarding value of Microsoft solutions over competitors. Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft solutions. Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates internal teams and local partners to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation. Drives account planning to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Influences customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of customer, partner and Microsoft towards customer’s digital transformation. Uses existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional level.
Responsibilities
Customer and Industry Insights
Generates business insights based on knowledge of the customer's technology landscape, engagement experience, and proactive collaboration with the customer, internal teams, and industry, to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts. Challenges customers to consider alternative business models to meet business and market needs, and adapts plans to insights. Orchestrates teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Leads technical teams for driving opportunities with other teams, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.
Applies expertise (deep expertise across few accounts or broad expertise across many accounts) in customer businesses. technology platforms, and maturity to build digital technology strategy with the customer that is aligned to business outcomes. Challenges customers’ assumptions with constructive dialogue about their business and technology. Leverages industry trends to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries.
Differentiated Value Proposition
Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with  leaders including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the CIO or CIO direct-report level by researching organization charts, identifying and contacting TDMs/BDMs, and beginning to advise on solutions and position Microsoft capabilities to best meet the customer's needs. Leads new opportunities and orchestrates internal teams to accelerate the customer business transformations through digital technologies by understanding the customer industry and position, engaging with customers to lead strategic technology direction/transformation within assigned accounts, and ensuring line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., testimonials) for referencing.
Drives conversations with enterprise customers that present the strategic relationship between Microsoft technologies, products, and services compared with the competitor's solution and the customer's overall business goals and objectives. Provides an outside-in perspective around compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.
Education and Thought Leadership
Uses existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional level. Contributes to innovations to accelerate meeting goals for customer capacity, maximize reach and impact, and drive long-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform. Supports customer skilling initiatives and execution.
Influences customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Contributes to the delivery of regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology decision-makers and technical teams.
Mapping and Account Planning
Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, and determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan.
Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
Drives account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates extended account teams and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.
Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
Identifies customer issues, creates demand, and creates opportunities to uncover new solutions. Creates and qualifies a set number of opportunities for product sales, solution sales, or consumption. Leverages partners to drive demand generation and capitalize on opportunities. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Works within a broader strategy to lead efforts with technical teams for driving opportunities including Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Contributes to efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues.
Introduces the customer to benefits of AI and Industrial Metaverse to create interest and excitement about Microsoft's capabilities and shows them how Microsoft technologies can help accelerate their productivity as well as differentiate themselves in the market. Creates follow-up opportunities and orchestrates appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) to pursue and close.
Technology Strategy Formulation
Creates mid- to long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) technology and business roadmaps for one or more accounts, to outline the digital transformation journey and core wins. Updates and articulates business changes in the roadmaps around foundational, traditional capabilities. Builds technical engagement or enablement plan, captures baseline, and drives envisioning to support mid- to long-term business plans. Discusses the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders. Translates an understanding of the customer's business objectives and scenarios in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays to develop technology architecture. Ensures that developed architecture influences cloud journey to position all Microsoft clouds and drives consumption, usage, and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
Ensures execution of technology strategy and/or digital transformation by identifying and resolving technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation and driving technology adoption.
Provides analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and potential blockers. Leverages understanding of business strategies and outcomes that technology can support to advise on gaps that would benefit from Microsoft solutions, and guides internal teams in overall strategy development (e.g., block identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end solutions.
Trusted Advisor
Proactively builds and maintains a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy in the industry of assigned accounts, as well as of the business priorities and potential threats the customers face. Leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Coordinates with internal industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts) to gather industry data of assigned accounts and leverages knowledge of competitors to improve planning. Demonstrates a strong understanding of the customer's business strategy and the direction of the industry.
Leverages account information technology (IT), industry, and business strategy to provide coaching to internal Microsoft teams on customer technology profiles and strategies. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge.
Advises customer technical decision maker (TDM) and business decision maker (BDM) stakeholders on the benefits of embedding security throughout their technology landscape through the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives. Establishes a sense of creating business value through implementing security and positions Microsoft's security credentials. Creates follow-up opportunities and orchestrates appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) to pursue and close.
Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers).

Microsoft-1970393557054263.description:
Overview
Builds and coaches others on customer, partner, and internal stakeholder engagement strategy and models. Identifies, navigates, communicates, and influences key customer technical, business, and executive-level stakeholders (including partners). Initiates the gathering of information on the business and Information Technology objectives for customer organizations using partnerships with other account team leaders to identify customer priorities. Understands, identifies, and aligns Microsoft solutions, and technical capabilities. Engages in conversations with customers and demonstrates alignment between customer objectives and the current Microsoft portfolio of work in the customer account. Leads the strategic execution of program planning and customer-facing program reviews, prioritization of engagements, and management of key stakeholder and executive expectations to address agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities to deliver ongoing customer success. Proactively identifies, monitors, and mitigates actual and potential blockers to consumption through data analysis and customer feedback.
Responsibilities
Customer Relationship Management
Identifies, navigates, communicates, and influences key customer technical, business, and executive-level stakeholders (including partners). Guides and leads conversations to facilitate the achievement of customer business objectives by leveraging their investment in Microsoft. Maps internal roles to customer priorities to action the needs of customers and provides input into customer priorities. Holds, maintains, and nurtures internal stakeholder relationships. Influences and challenges senior/executive internal stakeholders. Leads business value conversations at customer executive levels and incorporates a focus on security and resiliency.
Builds and coaches others on customer, partner, and internal stakeholder engagement strategy and models. Develops, maintains, and builds upon foundational relationships with key customer stakeholders and technical professionals to enable quality and secure solution delivery and health using partnerships with other account team leaders and leads orchestration across internal/external stakeholders. Expands customer and partner relationships beyond the current Unified Support contract consumers with a focus on leading the definition of business outcomes and how to align Microsoft strategy to customer business priorities.
Initiates the gathering of information on the business and Information Technology objectives for customer organizations using partnerships with other account team leaders to identify customer priorities. Partners with Account Team to create a customer success plan and contribute to the shared customer account plan in support of customer security and resiliency needs and customer objectives specific to the customer's business transformation programs and common to their industry.
Customer Success Leadership
Proactively identifies, monitors, and mitigates actual and potential blockers (including security and compliance concerns) to consumption through data analysis and customer feedback. Mobilizes resources to address actual and potential blockers to consumption, associated issues, and to ensure delivery on Customer Success Plans (CSPs). Holds accountability for identified consumption milestones and their completion. Partners with customers to proactively identify opportunities for growth, optimize usage, and drive adoption. Partners with customers to understand their business objectives, identify opportunities where Microsoft offerings can help achieve those objectives, and aligns Microsoft products and services to agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities. Leverages an understanding of the customer's needs and business objectives to identify opportunities where Microsoft can provide added value to maximize retention and minimize churn.
Engages in conversations with customers and demonstrates alignment between customer objectives and the current Microsoft portfolio of work in the customer account. Promotes the organizational and customer success strategy with customers. Aligns Microsoft technology and services with the customer's goals and objectives to form a cooperative strategy that includes security as a core component. Engages in account team planning, promoting business and technical needs for change that challenge customer thinking. Aligns with the account team to link Customer Success Plans (CSPs) with account plan priorities and develop bookable programs of work. Challenges the customer and influences their strategic decision making, driving the case for change towards improved operational health and security.
Leads the strategic execution of program planning and customer-facing program reviews, prioritization of engagements, and management of key stakeholder and executive expectations to address agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities to deliver ongoing customer success. Leverages Microsoft delivery management methodologies, processes, and tools to manage and improve customer operational health. Proactively identifies and mitigates customer blockers (including security and compliance risks) by leveraging Microsoft solutions and services, and develops deliverable programs of work. Orchestrates delivery resources to facilitate value realization with a focus on driving operational health. Leads delivery program reviews with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment on customer outcomes and account priorities. Leads escalation management and communications for delivery programs in the customer account.
Technical Relevance
Understands, identifies, and aligns Microsoft solutions, and technical capabilities (e.g., Azure, Security, Modern Work, Dynamics) to customer needs and priorities. Leverages broad foundational industry and technical expertise to enable customer success. Identifies complex customer scenarios (e.g., Independent Software Vendors [ISV], cross-cloud, partner) and aligns with technical specialists to identify relevant cross-cloud technology solutions. Strengthens Microsoft's position in the customers' cloud technology marketplace against competitors. Leverages understanding of the customer's technology platform and Microsoft's technology roadmap to enable customer digital transformation.

Microsoft-1970393556627526.title: DATACENTER INV & ASSET MANAGER
Microsoft-1970393556627526.description:
Overview
As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician Manager (DIAM), you will lead a team of Inventory & Asset Management technicians responsible for inbound/outbound logistics tasks, inventory cycle audits, and Data Center regulatory compliance activities. You will guide your employees to effectively run warranty processes and data bearing device (DBD) destruction. This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, drive focus on accurately and efficiently completing Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks, and work with stakeholders to manage escalations as they arise.
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities
Managers help deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring while promoting a positive and effective team culture.
Responsible for overall day-to-day operations and ensure inbound and outbound processes are running smoothly and effectively.
Assess resource and workflow patterns to determine any needed changes in work assignments to ensure timelines are met.
Support the planning, management, and communication of end-to-end project plans with applicable stakeholders and teams.
Ensure that all issues are documented, tracked, discussed, and resolved with internal and external stakeholders as well as suppliers with consistent and complete communication.
Coordinate and oversee relationships with any third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary ensuring all DBDs leaving premises do not contain customer information and are destroyed.
Comply with established methodologies and approaches to ensure delivery and execution of contracts and purchase orders.
Process price and procurement requests requested by Microsoft management in support of server, network, Storage Area Network (SAN), and spare requirements.
Provide thought leadership on established methodologies and monitor outcome.
Serve as subject matter expert and model compliance to junior team members.
Conduct or assist in conducting daily safety briefings, completes required safety training, provides guidance to technicians to facilitate compliance with safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, rack moving, heavy-equipment usage, lifting, ladder/rolling stair use).
Seek out opportunities to contribute to workstreams and evolve existing workstream processes, services, and solutions toward greater simplification and automation.
Embody our
culture
and
values
.

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
Services Sales Account Executive
to join Microsoft One Services Sales team, based in Shanghai. This role will focus on driving Microsoft Services business growth across Digital Native and Internet customers in East and South China.The ideal candidate brings strong experience in managing a large portfolio of customers, a deep understanding of the internet and technology industry, and a proven ability to identify and close consulting and support services opportunities.The role requires strong strategic selling capabilities, executive-level relationship management, and cross-team collaboration to accelerate customers' cloud and AI transformation through Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) and Unified Support offerings.
Responsibilities
Services Sales Growth:
Identify, develop, and close consulting and support services opportunities across a broad portfolio of Digital Native and Internet customers, driving revenue growth and customer success.
Account Strategy & Planning:
Develop and execute Services Sales account strategies aligned with customer business priorities, Microsoft Cloud consumption, and AI transformation initiatives.
Pipeline & Deal Management:
Own the end-to-end sales cycle, including opportunity qualification, solution positioning, proposal development, commercial negotiations, forecasting, and deal closure.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain trusted relationships with customer executives and key decision makers, understanding their business priorities and technology challenges to identify new opportunities.
Unified Support Growth:
Drive Unified Support acquisition, renewals, and upsell opportunities through proactive account engagement and value-based selling.
Cross-Team Orchestration:
Collaborate closely with Microsoft account teams, technical specialists, customer success teams, consulting and delivery organizations to deliver integrated solutions and a seamless customer experience.
Industry & Competitive Insights:
Stay current on cloud, AI, and internet industry trends, customer business models, and competitive offerings to position Microsoft Services effectively.
