Microsoft-1970393557005298.title: GCR Chief of Staff
Microsoft-1970393557005298.description:
Overview
The GCR Chief of Staff (COS) is a critical role that works closely with the Corporate Vice President and GCR Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and leads the GCR CEO Office in driving daily business operation, strategic project development and execution, internal communications, and organizational health. The CoS is responsible for ensuring the effectiveness of the CEO Office’s operating rhythm, including setting up and driving key processes and programs to get work done. The CoS will provide insight and advice to the GCR SLT around operational excellence, resource and fiscal planning, organization health & development, and participate in overall GCR strategy decisions and execution.  The CoS will also be involved in working with the Asia Co-President and the Asia Regional LT to identify and develop strategies and content to be used for team sharing, and executive reviews.
This role serves as a geared opportunity to understand the business aspects of a large-scale organization and growing overall product and sales related business context.
We are looking for a passionate, mission driven CoS to join this high performing team that keeps Microsoft as a Frontier Company in the AI era.
Responsibilities
Leadership Effectiveness
As the LT leads the business through transformational strategy moves and a fast-changing landscape, own LT & extended LT processes and agendas, including follow through and related communications to enable successful leadership of the organization.  Participate as a valued LT member and offer synthesized business perspectives relevant to influencing key strategic decisions.  Maximize the effectiveness of the Regional Vice President by helping balance priorities, communicate effectively, participate in the most relevant meetings, and connect with the team.
Team Development & Culture
Lead the D&I PM to help make the team a great place to work.  In partnership with HR and the LT, shape and drive the people agenda and lead team health initiatives.  Orchestrate team trainings and brownbag series to contribute to ongoing development.  Define, plan and drive cross-team process improvements (e.g., team recognition).
Communications
Lead the Comms Director to plan and execute Regional Vice President's communications strategy and vehicles that support organizational strategic missions.  Drive internal communications for team meetings and other internal communications at major milestones.  Plan and manage team meetings including All Hands, staff meetings and manager meetings.  In partnership with PR, manage the Regional Vice President’s external communications for customer/partner engagements, speaking engagements to ensure successful and impactful use of Regional Vice President’s time.
Product Planning and Special Projects
Work with the Regional Vice President, the Business Managers, and the LT to develop and implement different aspects of product planning.  For example, the Chief of Staff will be responsible for identifying product planning and OKRs across IDNA and work with Regional Vice President to develop the ROB i.e. what type of product reviews or documents are needed and develop a shared point of view.  Then the Chief of Staff would be expected to work with team leaders and participate in content creation.
Business Partner Relationships
Establishes and maintains key points of contact with internal teams (e.g., Finance, PR, HR, Marketing, RS&F, Business Development); manages and cultivates relationships with leaders of internal teams. Builds relationships with executive-level leaders (e.g., global executive sponsors, CVPs). Acts as an advisor to executive leadership on a particular area of expertise, leveraging breadth of deep technical/product knowledge, organizational context, and market awareness on strategic business decisions.
Strategic Project Leadership
Partner with Regional Vice President and the LT to define and manage Strategy project(s) as a project lead through goals, deliverables, feedback, and timing expectations, providing structure and guidance for others; proactively identify and address roadblocks. Manage projects independently and/or by leading project teams.
Business Integration
Drive strategic initiatives and provide thought leadership.  Identify issues that impede business group success and provide solutions/recommendations.  Identify opportunities to create cross group collaboration and synergies.  Partner with HR to orchestrate team design conversations and facilitate successful implementation of organizational plans.  Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when working with leadership team on sensitive business and organizational issues, manage ambiguity and propose workable solutions to business-critical problems.
Business
Planning
Partner with the LT to manage the planning process ensuring coordination with corporate planning processes as well as planning integration across the broader org.  Work with cross-division and cross-company/team counterparts to manage team participation as needed for key business events, next fiscal year planning, running business reviews, MPRs, MBRs and other strategic business planning activities.
Business Process

Overview
The GCR Chief of Staff (COS) is a critical role that works closely with the Corporate Vice President and GCR Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and leads the GCR CEO Office in driving daily business operation, strategic project development and execution, internal communications, and organizational health. The CoS is responsible for ensuring the effectiveness of the CEO Office’s operating rhythm, including setting up and driving key processes and programs to get work done. The CoS will provide insight and advice to the GCR SLT around operational excellence, resource and fiscal planning, organization health & development, and participate in overall GCR strategy decisions and execution.  The CoS will also be involved in working with the Asia Co-President and the Asia Regional LT to identify and develop strategies and content to be used for team sharing, and executive reviews.
This role serves as a geared opportunity to understand the business aspects of a large-scale organization and growing overall product and sales related business context.
We are looking for a passionate, mission driven CoS to join this high performing team that keeps Microsoft as a Frontier Company in the AI era.
Responsibilities
Leadership Effectiveness
As the LT leads the business through transformational strategy moves and a fast-changing landscape, own LT & extended LT processes and agendas, including follow through and related communications to enable successful leadership of the organization.  Participate as a valued LT member and offer synthesized business perspectives relevant to influencing key strategic decisions.  Maximize the effectiveness of the Regional Vice President by helping balance priorities, communicate effectively, participate in the most relevant meetings, and connect with the team.
Team Development & Culture
Lead the D&I PM to help make the team a great place to work.  In partnership with HR and the LT, shape and drive the people agenda and lead team health initiatives.  Orchestrate team trainings and brownbag series to contribute to ongoing development.  Define, plan and drive cross-team process improvements (e.g., team recognition).
Communications
Lead the Comms Director to plan and execute Regional Vice President's communications strategy and vehicles that support organizational strategic missions.  Drive internal communications for team meetings and other internal communications at major milestones.  Plan and manage team meetings including All Hands, staff meetings and manager meetings.  In partnership with PR, manage the Regional Vice President’s external communications for customer/partner engagements, speaking engagements to ensure successful and impactful use of Regional Vice President’s time.
Product Planning and Special Projects
Work with the Regional Vice President, the Business Managers, and the LT to develop and implement different aspects of product planning.  For example, the Chief of Staff will be responsible for identifying product planning and OKRs across IDNA and work with Regional Vice President to develop the ROB i.e. what type of product reviews or documents are needed and develop a shared point of view.  Then the Chief of Staff would be expected to work with team leaders and participate in content creation.
Business Partner Relationships
Establishes and maintains key points of contact with internal teams (e.g., Finance, PR, HR, Marketing, RS&F, Business Development); manages and cultivates relationships with leaders of internal teams. Builds relationships with executive-level leaders (e.g., global executive sponsors, CVPs). Acts as an advisor to executive leadership on a particular area of expertise, leveraging breadth of deep technical/product knowledge, organizational context, and market awareness on strategic business decisions.
Strategic Project Leadership
Partner with Regional Vice President and the LT to define and manage Strategy project(s) as a project lead through goals, deliverables, feedback, and timing expectations, providing structure and guidance for others; proactively identify and address roadblocks. Manage projects independently and/or by leading project teams.
Business Integration
Drive strategic initiatives and provide thought leadership.  Identify issues that impede business group success and provide solutions/recommendations.  Identify opportunities to create cross group collaboration and synergies.  Partner with HR to orchestrate team design conversations and facilitate successful implementation of organizational plans.  Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when working with leadership team on sensitive business and organizational issues, manage ambiguity and propose workable solutions to business-critical problems.

Planning
Partner with the LT to manage the planning process ensuring coordination with corporate planning processes as well as planning integration across the broader org.  Work with cross-division and cross-company/team counterparts to manage team participation as needed for key business events, next fiscal year planning, running business reviews, MPRs, MBRs and other strategic business planning activities.

Microsoft-1970393557039443.title: Operational Excellence
Microsoft-1970393557039443.description:
Overview
The Operational Excellence role will support the Sales Operations, Planning and Enablement functions within BSO, strengthening how we use data, technology and AI to drive better business decisions and execution.The role will bring together business analytics, data visualisation, scenario modelling and tooling to turn complex business information into clear, actionable insights. It will support BSO and Area teams in evaluating options and making informed decisions across areas such as fiscal year Planning, Fast Start, Segmentation, Territory design, Resource allocation. The role will also identify opportunities to simplify and improve how we work through AI, automation and fit-for-purpose tools, building scalable capabilities that improve productivity and enable more effective execution across the organisation.
Responsibilities
Data-driven decision support: Analyse large and complex datasets and translate them into clear, practical insights that enable BSO and Area leaders to make better-informed planning and operational decisions.
Data visualisation & Power BI: Design and build intuitive Power BI dashboards, analytical views and visualisations that surface the key trends, outliers, risks and opportunities behind the data, rather than simply reporting metrics.
Area insights: Develop clear, relevant Area/Subsidiary -level views and insights that enable Areas to understand their business, identify where action is required and make informed decisions.
Scenario modelling: Build analytical models and tools that allow teams to test different scenarios and understand the potential impact of decisions across segmentation, territories, resource allocation and other planning choices.
Fast Start enablement: Develop the analytical and modelling capabilities required to support Fast Start, giving BSO and Area teams clear visibility to support planning decisions and execution.
Enablement tooling: Develop and improve tools and digital capabilities that enable programmes and content to scale effectively across the organisation.
AI & automation: Identify practical opportunities to apply AI, Copilot and automation to simplify processes, improve the way data is consumed and reduce manual effort..

Proven ability to identify trends, outliers, patterns and opportunities within data.Experience building practical analytical tools and solutions to support business planning and decision-making.

Microsoft-1970393557054267.description:
Overview
The Partner Development Manager (PDM) is responsible for driving Microsoft’s growth and transformation agenda through  ESI partners in China. This role serves as a trusted advisor to partner executives and business leaders, helping partners build differentiated Microsoft practices, accelerate AI and Cloud transformation, and deliver measurable customer outcomes.
As a growth leader, the PDM owns partner business planning, executive engagement, co-sell execution, partner capability development, and performance management. The role works closely with Microsoft sales, technical, and marketing teams to align partner investments and resources with customer opportunities across Azure, Security, Data & AI, Business Applications, Copilot, and Frontier AI solutions.
The good candidate combines business acumen, partner management expertise, consultative selling skills, and a deep understanding of the local market technology and services ecosystem.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute Partner Business Plans (PBP) with assigned ESI partners to drive AI & Cloud growth and transformation.
Drive SI partners' revenue, pipeline, and co-sell outcomes across Azure, AIBS & Security and Copilot solutions.
Build trusted relationships with partner executives and align joint business priorities and investments.
Enable partners to develop AI, Cloud, and industry solutions that deliver customer success and business value.
Accelerate partner capabilities through skilling, solution designations, specializations, and marketplace initiatives.
Collaborate with Microsoft sales, technical, and marketing teams to identify opportunities and scale customer impact.
Monitor business performance, governance, and key success metrics to ensure execution excellence and predictable growth.

Microsoft-1970393557069807.title: Partner Solution Sales Manager
Microsoft-1970393557069807.description:
Overview
The Enterprise Partner Solution Sales (PSS) role drives Microsoft growth and customer transformation in China by delivering the Commercial Cloud customer promise through prioritized enterprise partners aligned to relevant solution areas. Working across Microsoft Cloud and AI offerings—such as Azure, Data & AI, Security, Business Applications, Copilot, and Frontier AI, as applicable—the role translates customer demand into focused partner sales execution and measurable business outcomes.
As a trusted solution-sales advisor, this role creates joint sales plans, builds and progresses qualified pipeline, and accelerates co-sell opportunities with partners and Microsoft sales teams. The role owns solution-area revenue, pipeline, and forecast accountability for assigned partners, while strengthening partner sales practices, capability, and capacity.
The ideal candidate
combines consultative selling, analytical rigor, operational excellence, and cross-functional influence to help customers advance their AI, Cloud, and digital transformation priorities.
Responsibilities
Create joint solution-area sales plans with prioritized enterprise partners, aligning customer-segment needs, Microsoft sales priorities, partner strengths, and quarterly revenue commitments.
Independently assess partner solution-area sales practices and align Microsoft, organizational-unit, and partner plans to clear sales objectives, execution milestones, and measurable performance indicators.
Accelerate partner Cloud and AI sales practices through pipeline development, go-to-market execution, co-sell motions, and a predictable rhythm of business that supports consistent execution.
Identify new customer opportunities with prioritized partners; build qualified pipeline, progress opportunities, and apply appropriate Microsoft investment levers to improve deal velocity and customer value.
Develop and execute co-sell strategies with segment sellers and key stakeholders, leading internal and external orchestration to resolve dependencies, accelerate decisions, and advance sales outcomes.
Own assigned top partner deals and solution-area revenue performance; maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts, monitor partner capability, capacity, and incentive utilization, and independently correct performance gaps.
Coach partners on solution plays and sales-practice acceleration; facilitate pipeline meetings, connect relevant resources, unblock opportunities, and lead business reviews that reinforce accountability for agreed actions.
Contribute subject-matter expertise by sharing co-sell best practices, competitive and market awareness, and customer-demand insights with partners, Microsoft stakeholders, and global peers.
Maintain high standards of operational excellence and uphold all Microsoft compliance, integrity, privacy, and responsible business requirements in partner and customer engagements.
Microsoft-1970393557069807.requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant experience in partner or channel sales, enterprise technology sales, solution sales, business development, or a related field.
Demonstrated track record of delivering quota or revenue results and managing pipeline, opportunity progression, and forecast accuracy in a complex sales environment.
Strong consultative-selling, sales-strategy, account-management, and opportunity-orchestration skills, with the ability to connect customer priorities to partner-led solution value.
Working knowledge of AI, Cloud, and digital transformation concepts, with the ability to communicate business and financial value to partner and customer stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence executives and cross-functional teams, make sound decisions, solve ambiguous problems, and collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries.
Strong business and financial analysis skills, market and competitive awareness, and the operational discipline to identify risks, prioritize actions, and close performance gaps.
Knowledge of Microsoft Cloud, AI, and enterprise technologies is preferred, including relevant experience with solution areas such as Azure, Data & AI, Security, Business Applications, or Copilot.
Fluent written and spoken English and Mandarin.

You will accelerate and close Security pipeline with partners and leverage investments to drive pipeline velocity in the SMB business

You will drive Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) revenue growth through a scalable portfolio of partners and coach partners on the value of Microsoft solution area plays and the corresponding sales levers to drive strong business outcomes
You will be responsible for Top Deals with pinned partners & working with VDS to update information in MSX (Microsoft Seller Experience tool)

Microsoft-1970393556984595.title: Principal Product Manager
Microsoft-1970393556984595.description:
Overview
Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s
workplace intelligence layer
, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first APIs, including the Work IQ API, CLI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, while respecting Microsoft Graph permissions, tenant policies, and compliance boundaries.
We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot extensibility engineering team, are looking for a Principal Product Manager for Work IQ whose
primary product focus is evaluation
— the load-bearing quality gate of the Work IQ agent developer lifecycle. Evaluation is where an agent earns the right to ship: it spans the committed eval suite and its correspondence to the success criteria declared at scoping, measurement across quality, accuracy, latency, cost, trust, DLP behavior, and source scoping, failure triage against the response playbook, and the advisory-board sign-off that governs what customers actually receive. You will own that gate end to end — including A/B testing with BizChat, the feedback loop from production signals back into the suite, and post-release drift detection — and you will make it fast, evidence-rich, and continuous rather than a milestone event.
This role is deliberately an
AI-native transformation
role, and it maps directly to the two M365 core priorities. On
Changing the Way We Work
, you are expected to redesign the lifecycle itself rather than staff it: apply an
agentic loop approach
to the evaluation stage so that evidence assembly, failure classification, remediation drafting, and drift detection run zero-touch, while accountable judgment — quality-gate sign-off, accepting a known failure into production, tenant admin consent, and any irreversible or externally visible action — stays with a named human by design. On
Leading with New AI Products
, you will dogfood Work IQ’s own surfaces to build those loops, so the platform team experiences its activation, evaluation, and metering surfaces as a developer does, and feeds that evidence straight back into the roadmap.
We are looking for a
growth mindset and thought leadership
measured in outcomes, not mechanism: human involvements per agent shipped trending toward zero for removable coordination toil, a rising acceptance rate for the loops’ recommendations, shrinking time from eval failure to resolution, a growing share of drift found by the platform before a customer reports it, and an absolute bar of
no agent-caused false gate pass
. You will set the point of view, publish it, and bring partner teams along.
This is a
platform PM role
at the intersection of
Copilot
,
agents
,
Graph
, and
enterprise trust
.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Evaluation & Quality — Primary Focus
Own the
evaluation stage
end to end: the eval suite and its baseline, measurement across quality, accuracy, latency, cost, trust, DLP behavior, and source scoping, failure triage, and the advisory-board quality gate.
Make evaluation
continuous rather than a milestone
, keep each agent’s eval suite in correspondence with its declared success criteria, and run A/B testing with BizChat plus post-release drift detection.
Protect the trust boundary: gate sign-off, accepting a known failure, and admin consent stay
accountable human decisions
, and every gate decision stays auditable.
AI-Native Transformation & Thought Leadership
Changing the Way We Work:
apply an
agentic loop approach
to evaluation so evidence assembly, failure triage, and drift detection run zero-touch — while irreversible or customer-visible decisions stay human.
Leading with New AI Products:
dogfood Work IQ’s own surfaces to build those loops, and turn that developer experience into platform investments.
Lead with
outcomes and a published point of view
: less human effort per agent shipped, faster resolution of eval failures, drift caught before customers see it — and never a false gate pass.
Product Vision & Strategy
Define and drive the
product vision and roadmap
for the focused Work IQ areas serving for the core Copilot extensibility
Clarify what Work IQ focus areas provide vs. what is handled by Copilot Chat, Microsoft Graph, or agent frameworks
Translate customer, partner, and internal agent scenarios into clear engineering investments and priorities
Make
evaluation a first-class product surface
, not an internal process: define what the platform owes developers in eval tooling, evidence, and quality signals, and decide how much of it extends to third-party developers versus first-party and contributing teams.
Ownership
Own the
Work IQ focus area contract
Ensure APIs are
composable, predictable, and production‑ready
for enterprise workloads
Partner with engineering on versioning, backward compatibility, and preview/GA readiness
Agent & Developer Experience
Design
agentic usage patterns
, and enable various scenarios
Shape developer experience across SDKs, CLI, MCP integrations, and documentation
Enterprise Trust, Security, and Compliance
Partner with security, privacy, and compliance teams to define safe defaults and guardrails
Avoid over‑inference and ambiguity that could erode enterprise trust
Cross‑Team Leadership
Establish strong collaboration partnership and trust with local and global engineering stakeholders.
Work closely with:
Copilot platform and BizChat teams
Microsoft Graph and Entra PM counterparts
Agent platforms (Copilot Studio, Agent SDKs, Foundry)
Drive alignment through clear specs, decision docs, and executive‑ready communication
Represent strategy in reviews, shiprooms, and partner discussions

Microsoft-1970393557069976.title: Principal Product Manager(M365 Core)
Microsoft-1970393557069976.description:
Overview
Do you want to create products used by tens of thousands of engineers? Are you energized by complex problems with competing priorities, cloud services, safe deployment, and large-scale distributed systems? Do you want to help engineering teams ship fast-growing Copilot features with confidence?
M365 Core owns a feature management platform used by thousands of Microsoft services. The platform provides the reliability, availability, and safety guardrails services need as they introduce features and roll out changes at global scale.
In this role, you will independently define strategy for a major product area and work with global product managers, engineers, designers, applied scientists, and partner teams to shape an enterprise-grade product that optimizes safety and agility across production development and operations.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Defines the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for how AI agents transform production development and operations; translates that vision into prioritized investments and measurable customer, engineering, and operational outcomes at large scale.
Owns the end-to-end agentic AIOps experience, connecting operational signals, incidents, service context, code and configuration changes, and engineering knowledge so agents can assess service health, recommend next steps, and help engineers move incidents toward resolution.
Builds the evaluation and trust framework for production AI agents, defining durable metrics and evaluation methods for reasoning, grounding, diagnosis, recommended actions, safety, human oversight, and operational outcomes.
Sets durable platform and product standards for change management, safe rollout, and AI-enabled engineering experiences, balancing consistent safety guardrails with the flexibility services need to innovate quickly.
Leads across organizational boundaries to align engineering, applied science, product, design, and partner teams on architectural contracts, product priorities, evaluation standards, and the evolution toward AI-native operations.
Surfaces difficult trade-offs, resolves complex dependencies, and drives decisions to closure by influencing senior stakeholders and multiple organizations without direct authority.
Demonstrates strong end-to-end product leadership, from customer discovery and strategy through execution, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement, delivering clear outcomes for a major product area.
Proactively identifies and initiates opportunities for new areas with a growth mindset, customer focus, and a high bar for innovation and product quality.

6+ years experience disrupting a market for a product, feature, or experience (e.g., competitive disruption, taking the place of an established competing product).
Solid demonstrated track record of independently leading a major product area end to end and delivering measurable customer, platform, and operational outcomes at scale.
Ability to turn highly ambiguous, technically complex problems into product strategy, requirements, measurable outcomes, prioritized roadmaps, and durable platform standards.
Exceptional technical judgment, communication, and cross-functional influence, including experience aligning senior stakeholders and multiple organizations, making difficult trade-offs, and driving decisions without direct authority.
Experience with cloud operations, reliability, observability, incident management, feature management, safe deployment, progressive rollout, or the AIOps lifecycle for large-scale distributed systems.
Experience building AI/ML products, agentic experiences, or intelligent automation, including grounding, evaluation, safety, human oversight, and trust for production use.

Microsoft-1970393557047953.title: Senior Asia P&L Controller
Microsoft-1970393557047953.description:
Overview
The Senior Asia P&L Controller is responsible for driving the Rhythm of Business (RoB) for the Asia GES P&L management, ensuring financial performance is effectively monitored, communicated, and actioned. This role acts as the primary liaison between Asia stakeholders  and the Core Finance team, translating financial results into actionable business insights and ensuring alignment on forecasting, reporting, planning, and strategic priorities.
The successful candidate will lead business performance reviews, coordinate planning cycles, manage financial governance processes, and provide data-driven recommendations that support revenue growth, profitability, and operational excellence.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Rhythm of Business Leadership
Lead and manage the end-to-end Rhythm of Business (RoB) calendar, including monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews.
Coordinate performance review meetings, ensuring alignment across business leaders, finance partners, and operational stakeholders.
Develop executive-level business performance summaries, dashboards, and presentations.
Track business commitments, action items, risks, and opportunities arising from review discussions.
P&L Performance Management
Provide insights into business drivers, trends, variances, and key financial metrics.
Consolidate risks and opportunities against budget, forecast, and strategic targets.
Support scenario planning and decision-making through financial modeling and business analysis.
Finance Partnership & Coordination
Partner with Asia P&L team and Core Finance teams to serve as the intermediary between the two teams
Coordinate financial planning processes including budgeting, forecasting, and month-end reviews.
Drive alignment on financial assumptions, reporting requirements, and performance metrics.
Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial information communicated across stakeholders.
Strategic Business Insights
Translate complex financial reporting requirements into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for Asia P&L team.
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve operational and financial performance.
Governance & Operational Excellence
Ensure adherence to financial governance standards and compliance requirements.
Drive process improvements in reporting, forecasting, and business review activities.
Establish best practices for reporting automation and performance tracking.
Support organizational planning initiatives and strategic projects.

Microsoft-1970393557037925.title: Sr Account Executive
Microsoft-1970393557037925.description:
Overview
Proactively cultivates relationships with customers and uses Microsoft sales strategies to establish alignment and secure buy in and execution. Proactively develops a comprehensive understanding of customer's needs and strategies, priorities, and industry direction. Leads digital transformation to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers. Develops and oversees the execution of account plans to ensure engagements yield high volume sales for both Microsoft and the customer. Thinks strategically about account planning, setting standards and priorities, outlining where to and how to invest resources. Oversees a complex accounts and leads planning and prioritization efforts to ensure appropriate responses to account needs. Engages with key internal partners to promote long-term, mutually-beneficial digital transformation strategies. Leverages key executive relationships to build trust with the customer organization. Leverages best-in-class sales and communication techniques to lead extended virtual teams and key stakeholders with deep industry expertise. Translates features into business impact and outcomes that accelerate the customer's digital presence. Develops compelling, value-proposition presentations and specialized business plans for customers that drive business outcomes. Develops and implements plans for maximizing upselling/cross-selling opportunities in certain accounts. Proactively coordinates with network of industry experts to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape.
Responsibilities
Account Management
Develops and oversees the execution of account plans utilizing common sales and delivery methodology for the Microsoft sales organization for multiple accounts and works to ensure engagements yield high volume sales for both Microsoft and the customer that are on track with goals, outcomes, and forecasts. Leads multiple, diverse, and high-performing teams and coordinates with internal industry experts on account planning and execution for various accounts. Coordinates with industry experts to identify new business opportunities and drive account growth. Leads extended team and embraces partners to scale business by understanding partner goals and creating an interest in mutual business growth, and deep understanding of plan to ensures achievement of revenue and consumption targets and drives integrated joint account governance through customer plan on regular frequency to achieve customer outcomes. Identifies initial stakeholders, customer needs, and customer priorities. Proposes initial Solutions/Sales Plays. Leverages strong sales acumen to set action items and approach to drive big bets and drive new business opportunities based on customer strategy and priorities.
Thinks strategically about customer planning for assigned accounts, setting standards and priorities, outlining where to and how to invest resources of the account management team and other stakeholders, engaging internal and external decision makers on long-term business planning, and anticipating needs of assigned accounts to turn enterprise accounts into strategic accounts. Influences to scale strategic plans (inclusive of partners) and involves leadership team. Ensures teams are documenting in the Account Plan.
Expands network of key internal (e.g., Industry Solutions [IS]) and external partners and other business decision makers in customers' accounts to grow sales and partner impact and to provide a seamless account management experience to the customers, ensuring proper execution of core tasks and account transactions. Engages with key mainstream partners to promote long-term, mutually-beneficial business and technology transformation strategies. Expands network of influence on the board to expand reach and influence decision making. Drives joint solutions with partners. Where applicable, shares opportunities outbound with partners, and reviews/accepts opportunities shared inbound. Proactively engages and works with partners’ sellers directly to drive non-qualified opportunity momentum and deal closure inclusive of partners.
Oversees a complex/multiple account(s) and leads planning and prioritization efforts to anticipate and ensure appropriate responses to account needs. Develops strategies to manage pipeline and meet sales goals by reviewing forecasts, assessing and mitigating risks, and ensuring strategy alignment with business priorities. Leads virtual teams to properly re-adjust priorities, all while maintaining a high level of commitment and accountability. Prioritizes line of business projects to achieve business outcomes. Reduces complexity for the customer and for internal teams by prioritizing the most strategic partners to deliver outcomes.
Customer Engagement
Supports business transformation through technology for assigned accounts in multiple business units to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers. Leverages consultative and insightful listening skills that disrupts the mindset of customers by bringing innovative ideas that showcase the need for change and new strategic direction. Is sought out by the customer for guidance related to transformation. Proactively involves corporate resources and engages cross-industry resources to drive customer transformation. Ability to influence and mitigate proactively competitive risk. Ensures line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., customer write ups) as reference for scale through insightful listening.
Proactively cultivates relationships with customers and uses Microsoft sales strategies with executive, business, and technical decision makers at high levels of the customer's organization through consultative engagement to establish alignment and secure buy-in and execution. Connects the customer to Microsoft business and technical executives. Establishes Rhythm of Business (RoB) with top customer sponsors to regularly highlight the value of the Microsoft solutions and subsequent Return on Investment (ROI). Works with the customer partners foster trust and brand growth and loyalty through multiple levels (e.g., managers, executives) of the customer's organization in the assigned accounts. Assists partners in joint-selling by establishing joint desire to create new go-to markets by starting to build relationships in new markets (e.g., Vice President). Leverages digital selling methods (e.g., digital) to grow your network and create a pipeline, consume account-based marketing output, and reflect in the engagement strategy in our customer plan.
Proactively develops a comprehensive understanding of customer's business and technology needs and strategies for each assigned account, of their priorities, and of the industry direction. Anticipates customers' needs to deliver new insights on customers' business strategies and educate customers on ways to jointly address these needs. Identifies and pursues opportunities to offer business and technology solutions. Leverages internal influence to advocate on behalf of the customer internally (e.g., driving changes to roadmap, engaging with product groups), working to prioritize customers' requests and meeting their business needs. Creates trust to influence for impact and acts as a trusted advisor to help the customer transform its business model. Connect customers with other customers/partners on areas that may benefit them. If industry aligned, also develops a deep understanding of the customer's industry.
Industry Knowledge
If aligned by industry, exhibits deep knowledge of the industry, current trends, and market dynamics, and the competitive landscape. Leverages their depth of industry knowledge to position Solution Area technology in industry context. Demonstrated ability to position how Microsoft products and solutions will help customers realize innovation through business transformation.
Sales Excellence
Develops compelling, value-proposition presentations (e.g., with the use of business cases) and specialized business plans for customers that drive business outcomes. Demonstrates thought leadership and presents business plans to customers to generate new non-qualified opportunities. Guides others on how to tailor industry-specific presentations. Presents outcome based cross solution strategies.
Develops and implements plans for maximizing upselling/cross-selling non-qualified opportunities in certain accounts. Drives plans to highlight Microsoft's and partners' solutions to solving additional business and technology issues and aims to expand budget allocated to Microsoft. Leverages virtual teams to identify and act on new non-qualified opportunities while utilizing common sales and delivery methodology for the Microsoft sales organization.
Engages decision makers of assigned accounts to clearly articulate Microsoft's value proposition aligned to customer's business objectives. Translates features into business impact and outcomes that accelerate the customer's digital presence. Develops plans to offer more targeted solutions that satisfy customers' key performance indicators (KPIs) and align the right partner solution for customer industry needs.
Positions oneself as a thought leader and trusted advisor internally and externally to executive-level business decision makers of multiple assigned accounts by leveraging best-in-class sales and communication techniques to lead extended virtual teams and key stakeholders with deep industry expertise (e.g., customers' sponsors) to build stronger relationships with decision makers of assigned accounts. Document and creates stakeholder map in the account plan of the key decision makers, influencers, sentiment, etc.
Actively seeks customer feedback (both formal and informal) of assigned accounts regarding ways to identify and understand the drivers of satisfaction and/or dissatisfaction. Helps in the creation of long-term strategies aimed at maintaining levels of customer satisfaction. Orchestrates others (e.g., Customer Success Account Management [CSAM]) to anticipate issues/risks on customer satisfaction, determine the root cause of problems, remove blockers, and establish recovery action plan to improve customer's overall experience. Leverages key executive relationships to build trust with the customer organization. Proactively establishes agreement on success measures and manages execution on success measures to prevent need for recovery plans.

Microsoft-1970393556876319.title: Sr Services AE
Microsoft-1970393556876319.description:
Overview
Are you ready to help redefine how we sell services? Join a dynamic, forward-thinking sales team that’s transforming the customer experience. We’re looking for innovative, collaborative professionals who thrive in fast-paced environments, bring informal leadership to the table, and know how to align competing priorities to drive shared success.
Our organization is all about unlocking value for customers by aligning their business goals with transformative solutions. It goes beyond selling products—it's about building trusted partnerships, understanding customer challenges, and delivering tailored services that drive measurable outcomes. Through consultative engagement, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration, services sellers empower organizations to innovate, grow, and succeed in a digital-first world while guiding the AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI. We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.
As an experienced Services Account Manager, this role will give you the opportunity to accelerate your career growth, be part of a high performing team and develop, own and close strategic opportunities that leverage AI and cutting-edge solutions for customers that grow consumption.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Microsoft-1970393557069864.description:
Overview
Brings impactful industry insights into customer engagements and closes deals with customers. Explores and assesses the needs of strategic/high-potential customers. Articulates business value and long-term implications for customer business. Develops strategies for driving and closing strategic and/or prioritized opportunities. Leads the planning and execution on opportunities with resources and partners to cross-sell and up-sell. Mentors others and develops strategies for best practice sharing across subsidiaries. Leverages and shares competitor knowledge across solution areas as a subject matter expert to inform decisions on pursuit or withdrawal. Coaches others on ensuring customer/partner satisfaction and decreasing dissatisfaction by establishing recovery action plans to improve clients' overall experience. Manages the end-to-end business for strategic accounts across the organization. Leads forecasting for accounts and develops a portfolio and territory plan to drive intentional selling with on-strategy engagements in high-propensity accounts.
Responsibilities
Business Relationship Management
The ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with supervisors, staff, managers, customers, and vendors. This includes expressing empathy and compassion when dealing with the needs and problems of others, being approachable, taking time to address the concerns of coworkers, and treating others with respect and dignity.
Conflict Resolution
The ability to manage conflict, disharmony, and strife among people and situations, while recognizing and addressing sensitivities.
Creativity
The ability to apply ingenuity, inventiveness, and imagination to the inclusive design and construction of a product, service, program, or initiative.
Change Management
The ability to define and implement procedures and/or technologies to deal with changes in the environment. This may include adapting to change, controlling change, and/or affecting change.
Conflict ResolutionThe ability to manage conflict, disharmony, and strife among people and situations, while recognizing and addressing sensitivities.
Consultative Selling
The ability to understand customer needs through dialogue before recommending products/services.
CreativityThe ability to apply ingenuity, inventiveness, and imagination to the inclusive design and construction of a product, service, program, or initiative.
Decision Making
The ability to make decisions in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. This includes the ability to define, diagnose, and determine an appropriate resolution, recommendation, or decision while considering alternatives and factors (e.g., resources, costs, tradeoffs).

Microsoft-1970393557047493.title: Strategic Account Technology Strategist
Microsoft-1970393557047493.description:
Overview
As an Account Technologist in support the Big 4 in APAC region you have a unique opportunity to translate business priorities into an integrated AI, data, cloud and security roadmap, influencing executive decisions rather than simply recommending products. Help move tax, audit and advisory workflows from experimentation toward production. APAC engagements already include AI-powered tax platforms, governed data foundations and agentic workflows.
Bring Microsoft specialists, engineering, services and partners together to remove technical barriers and drive adoption, consumption and business outcomes. This role gives you the opportunity to help shape how the Big 4 transform with AI across APAC, while expanding your executive relationships, regional experience and ability to lead complex technology.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
You generate innovative business insights, orchestrate teams to develop insights, and apply expertise in customer business in alignment with customer goals.
You act as the "virtual Technical Officer," providing technical guidance to teams, building and maintaining strong industry and client knowledge, and acting as the voice of the customer (VOC).
You create mid- to long-term digital transformation roadmaps while ensuring the execution of technological strategy, providing analysis of customer needs, and translating customer business objectives to develop technology architecture.
You lead industry and digital transformation acceleration to identify, create demand, and deliver customer solutions. You drive new opportunities, lead internal teams to accelerate customer digital transformation, and drive conversations regarding the value of Microsoft solutions over competitors.
You help customer technical specialists sell Microsoft solutions. You map technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms.
You orchestrate internal teams and local partners to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation. You drive account planning to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. You influence customer technology engagement by engaging technical resources of a customer, partner, and Microsoft towards the customer's digital transformation. You use existing and new readiness resources to support enablement plans for customer technology adoption at the national and regional level.
Microsoft-1970393557047493.requirements:
Required Qualifications (RQs)
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 4+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience
OR equivalent experience
Preferred Qualifications (PQs)
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business
OR related field AND 8+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building
OR related technical/sales experience
OR equivalent experience
4+ years experience in relevant customer industry
4+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes
Enterprise technology strategy: Experience translating business priorities into actionable technology roadmaps and measurable customer outcomes.
Executive engagement: Ability to lead credible conversations with CIOs, CTOs and business leaders, explain architectural trade-offs and constructively challenge assumptions.
AI and security leadership: Experience shaping secure AI transformation, with sufficient technical breadth to connect cloud, data, productivity and governance.
Cross-functional orchestration: Experience aligning account teams, technical specialists, services and partners around a unified customer strategy.
Commercial acumen: Ability to connect technology decisions to adoption, value realization and account growth.
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.
